job.title: Sales Engineer - Service Sales
job.description:
Introduction / Context
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with a leading organisation in the Industrial sector to hire a Sales Engineer - Service Sales. This opportunity is based in Malaysia.
Position Overview
To drive aftermarket sales activities for cryogenic pumps and turbo expander solutions while supporting the growth of the service business across assigned territories.
This role plays a key role in expanding recurring service revenue, strengthening customer partnerships, and contributing to the organisation’s long-term aftermarket growth strategy.
Key Responsibilities

  • Follow up customers’ inquiries and technical requests, understand technical specifications, and prepare commercial quotations.
  • Work with the Regional Sales Manager to create a business development plan.
  • Provide and achieve targets to grow the Service Business unit to maximize volume and profitability.
  • Promote and sell aftermarket products, including Service Agreements, Repairs, Field Services and Upgrades as offered to all existing and new customers.
  • Be responsible for the maintenance and growth of the Service Contract business for all product groups in the assigned sales territory.
  • Evaluate needs and negotiate contracts directly with key accounts or indirectly with 3rd Party Service Providers subject to designation of authority.
  • Develop existing and build new customer relationships ensuring the organisation is seen as a long-term business partner.
  • Aid prime equipment sales by maintaining and developing effective, working customer relationships via valued service products.
  • Develop proposal for aftermarket sales campaigns for specific service products and markets/customers and align campaigns with the BLM, PLM and Business Development Manager leadership before execution.
  • Monitor changes and developments within the industry and report to management.
  • Promote the full product portfolio, follow-up and share sales leads internally.
  • Document activities in the CRM program, Salesforce.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Key Requirements
Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Master of Business Administration (MBA) preferred but not essential.
  • At least 3 years of progressive sales experience in a similar industry or related field.
  • 3 to 8 years of experience in aftermarket sales for cryogenic applications is preferred.
  • Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets.
  • Experience in managing and leading a sales team.
  • Familiarity with various sales techniques and methodologies.
  • Experience within industrial gases, air separation, LNG, cryogenic equipment, clean energy, alternative fuels, marine, or related industrial sectors is advantageous.
  • Ability and willingness to travel globally.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Experience in aftermarket sales of cryogenic pumps, turbo expanders, and related service solutions.
  • Ability to understand technical specifications and prepare commercial quotations.
  • Knowledge of Service Agreements, Repairs, Field Services, Upgrades, and Service Contract business models.
  • Experience developing and executing business development plans.
  • Ability to negotiate contracts with key accounts and third-party service providers.
  • Experience creating and executing aftermarket sales campaigns.
  • Proficiency in CRM systems, particularly Salesforce.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to assess market trends, competitor activities, and sales performance data.
  • Proficiency in using sales analytics tools and CRM platforms.
  • Strong product knowledge and ability to communicate technical features, benefits, and value propositions effectively.
  • Sound understanding of industry trends, market dynamics, and competitor landscape.
  • Ability to support cross-functional sales initiatives and share leads internally.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Strong sales, negotiation, and deal-closing capabilities.
  • Demonstrated leadership skills with the ability to set goals, delegate tasks, and evaluate performance.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and listening communication skills.
  • Ability to deliver persuasive presentations and articulate sales strategies effectively.
  • Strong relationship-building and networking capabilities with customers, stakeholders, and business partners.
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to identify market opportunities and develop tailored sales plans.
  • Exceptional problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.
  • Self-driven and highly motivated with a proactive approach to business development.
  • Strong commercial acumen and customer-focused mindset.
  • Ability to read, write, and speak English; multilingual capability is desirable.
  • Ability to work effectively across different cultures and regions.

job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
Introduction / Context
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with a leading organisation in the Industrial sector to hire a Project Manager. This opportunity is based in Malaysia.
Position Overview
To lead the planning, execution, and monitoring of projects to ensure successful delivery in accordance with quality, safety, and organisational standards.
This role plays a critical part in ensuring project excellence, stakeholder coordination, and the achievement of business objectives through effective project management.
Key Responsibilities

  • To plan, execute and monitor projects to ensure smooth implementation of project according to company policies and procedures to ensure quality, timely delivery and upkeep of safety standard.
  • To supervise and monitor day-to-day activities on project sites.
  • To take charge of Quality Assurance/Quality Control and supervision at sites:-
  • Implement the QA/QC management system at site.
  • Coordinate with the contractors/consultants and customers on all quality matters.
  • Implement the company ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System.
  • Control all non-conformance reports and undertake relevant training to the site QC inspector.
  • Ensure the safety is adhered to at site.
  • To liaise with project consultants, contractors and any other relevant personnel on all technical and / or site matters.
  • To coordinate consultant coordination meeting and contractor monthly site meeting.
  • To prepare all necessary report as required.
  • To verify work programme submitted by contractor and to recommend for acceptance of contractor’s implementation proposal against company objectives.
  • Responsible to provide necessary mentoring and job-related training to any junior staff under your supervision.

Key Requirements
Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.
  • Proven experience managing industrial, engineering, construction, infrastructure, or related projects.
  • Experience supervising project site activities and coordinating with multiple stakeholders.
  • Experience in Quality Assurance and Quality Control management at project sites.
  • Experience mentoring, coaching, and developing junior team members.
  • Proven track record in project delivery within quality, schedule, and safety requirements.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Project planning, execution, and monitoring expertise.
  • Strong understanding of QA/QC management systems and site supervision practices.
  • Experience implementing ISO 9001:2015 Quality Management System requirements.
  • Knowledge of non-conformance reporting and corrective action processes.
  • Ability to review and verify contractors' work programmes and implementation proposals.
  • Strong technical knowledge in site management and project execution.
  • Experience coordinating with consultants, contractors, customers, and other project stakeholders.
  • Ability to prepare project reports and project documentation.
  • Sound understanding of workplace safety standards and compliance requirements.
  • Competence in contractor management and project progress monitoring.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Strong leadership and team management skills.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities.
  • Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong organisational and coordination capabilities.
  • Problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple priorities.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Strong mentoring and coaching abilities.
  • Proactive, responsible, and results-oriented approach.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.

job.title: Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with a leading organisation within the Industrial sector to hire a Chief Financial Officer (CFO). This leadership opportunity is based in Sepang, Selangor, and is suited for a commercially driven finance executive with a proven track record in strategic financial leadership, business transformation and operational excellence.

Position Overview

Lead the organisation's financial strategy, governance and performance management while serving as a strategic partner to the Chief Executive Officer and leadership team.
Drive sustainable growth, profitability, operational efficiency and long-term value creation across multiple business pillars through data-driven financial leadership.

Key Responsibilities

Own It:

  • Lead the overall financial strategy of the organisation, aligned with business priorities and Group financial policies.
  • Act as the strategic financial partner to the CEO, Board and leadership team on business performance, growth opportunities, investments and key financial decisions.
  • Lead FP&A across Ground Handling, Inflight Catering, Cargo and Engineering, providing a forward-looking view of performance, risks and opportunities.
  • Own the annual budget, rolling forecasts, long-range financial plans and scenario modelling across all four business pillars.
  • Establish clear financial and operational KPIs covering revenue, profitability, margins, volume, productivity, cash flow, working capital and returns.
  • Provide clear performance visibility by business pillar, customer, airline, station, contract and service line.
  • Lead monthly business performance reviews, identifying variances against budget and forecast, underlying business drivers and required corrective actions.
  • Develop scenarios across revenue, volume, manpower, cost, capex and cash flow to support forward-looking business decisions.
  • Lead financial evaluation and business cases for new customer contracts, partnerships, business opportunities, investments and major capital expenditure.
  • Drive rigorous assessment of pricing, contract profitability, cost-to-serve, manpower productivity, asset utilisation and return on investment.
  • Identify underperforming businesses, customers or contracts and work with business leaders to implement improvement and turnaround plans.
  • Ensure accurate and timely management, statutory and Group financial reporting.
  • Oversee treasury, cash flow, taxation, credit management and working capital optimisation.
  • Proactively identify financial and commercial risks and ensure appropriate mitigation plans are implemented.

Build Trust:

  • Uphold the highest standards of financial integrity, transparency, governance and accountability.
  • Provide the CEO, Board and Group Finance with accurate, timely and meaningful financial insights to support decision-making.
  • Ensure strong financial controls, policies and governance are embedded across all four business pillars.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards, taxation, statutory requirements and Group policies.
  • Provide early visibility of emerging financial risks, performance gaps and control issues, supported by clear recommendations and actions.
  • Maintain strong relationships with auditors, banks, tax advisers, regulators and relevant external stakeholders.
  • Build financial discipline and accountability across the business, ensuring leaders understand and own their financial performance.

One Team:

  • Act as the strategic Finance business partner to the leaders of Ground Handling, Inflight Catering, Cargo and Engineering.
  • Embed FP&A and commercial finance capabilities across the business, ensuring Finance works alongside Operations and Commercial teams to understand the drivers behind business performance.
  • Partner with Operations to improve productivity, manpower economics, cost efficiency, asset utilisation and station performance.
  • Partner with Commercial teams on pricing, contract economics, customer profitability, tenders and new business opportunities.
  • Challenge business assumptions and provide data-driven recommendations on volume, pricing, manpower, productivity, cost and margins.
  • Support the CEO and leadership team in evaluating strategic initiatives, partnerships, investments and expansion opportunities.
  • Optimise resource and capital allocation across the four business pillars based on strategic priorities and expected returns.
  • Work closely with Group Finance to ensure alignment on financial governance, reporting and Group priorities.
  • Build and develop a high-performing Finance team with strong technical, FP&A, analytical and commercial capabilities.
  • Move Finance beyond reporting towards business partnering, insight, challenge and value creation.

Move Fast:

  • Provide timely and actionable financial insights to enable faster and better-informed decisions.
  • Develop agile rolling forecasts, scenario planning and financial modelling to respond quickly to changing business and market conditions.
  • Continuously assess actual performance against budget and forecast and identify emerging risks and opportunities early.
  • Work with business leaders to implement corrective actions where performance is below expectations.
  • Simplify Finance processes, management reporting and approval workflows without compromising governance or controls.
  • Enable rapid assessment of commercial and investment opportunities through robust financial modelling and business cases.
  • Ensure Finance remains responsive to the operational requirements of all four business pillars.

Drive Innovation:

  • Lead the transformation and digitalisation of the Finance function.
  • Maximise the use of SAP, analytics and automation to strengthen financial controls, forecasting, reporting and decision-making.
  • Develop integrated FP&A dashboards combining financial and operational KPIs to provide a holistic view of business performance.
  • Improve forecasting capability and accuracy through better data, analytics and scenario modelling.
  • Drive automation and simplification of transactional activities, allowing Finance to focus increasingly on analysis, insights and business partnering.
  • Strengthen data-driven financial modelling to support pricing, resource planning, capacity decisions, capex and profitability management.
  • Progressively move Finance from historical reporting towards predictive and forward-looking business insights.
  • Continuously benchmark Finance practices against leading aviation, logistics and service organisations.

Delight Customers:

  • Partner with Commercial and Operations teams to ensure customer propositions are competitive, financially viable and sustainable.
  • Provide financial modelling and insights to support customer proposals, pricing strategies, tenders and contract negotiations.
  • Ensure major customer and airline contracts have clear visibility of revenue, cost-to-serve, margins, risks and expected returns.
  • Track actual contract performance against the original business case and identify opportunities for margin improvement.
  • Balance customer requirements with the organisation's commercial and financial objectives.
  • Support the development of win-win commercial solutions that deliver customer value while generating sustainable returns.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline.
  • Professional accounting qualification such as ACCA, CPA, CIMA, ICAEW or equivalent.
  • Membership with the Malaysian Institute of Accountants (MIA), where applicable.
  • Preferably 12 to 15+ years of progressive Finance experience, including significant senior finance leadership experience.
  • Strong experience across FP&A, financial management, accounting and reporting, commercial finance, treasury, governance, risk and business partnering.
  • Experience within aviation, ground handling, logistics, transportation, engineering, catering, services or another operationally complex business would be highly advantageous.
  • Strong FP&A capability with demonstrated experience in budgeting, forecasting, scenario modelling, variance analysis and long-range financial planning.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner with CEOs and senior leadership teams on strategy, performance, investments and transformation.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to connect financial and operational performance and translate data into clear business insights and actions.
  • Strong understanding of contract profitability, pricing, cost-to-serve, working capital, capex and investment evaluation.
  • Experience with SAP, ERP, finance transformation, automation and data-driven management reporting would be advantageous.
  • Proven ability to build and lead high-performing Finance teams with strong business-partnering capabilities.
  • Expertise in financial strategy, FP&A, accounting and reporting, treasury management, governance, risk management, financial controls and finance transformation.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the credibility to engage senior management, Board members and external stakeholders.
  • High integrity, sound judgement and a strong governance mindset.
  • Able to operate effectively in a fast-paced, operational and transformation environment.
  • Strategic, forward-thinking and commercially driven leadership approach.
  • Strong analytical, decision-making and business partnering capabilities.

job.title: Environment, Safety, Security & Quality Management (EHSSQ) Manager
job.description:
Environment, Safety, Security & Quality Management (EHSSQ) Manager

Introduction

Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Industrial sector to hire an Environment, Safety, Security & Quality Management (EHSSQ) Manager. This opportunity is based in Teluk Kalong, Terengganu, Malaysia.

Position Overview

Accountable for developing, implementing and sustaining an integrated EHSSQ management system for a TiO₂ sulphate manufacturing site.
Ensures legal compliance, risk reduction and a strong safety culture, safeguarding people, the environment and the site’s operations.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Health & Safety Management
    a. Lead site-wide Process Safety and Occupational Safety programmes aligned with sulphate TiO₂ hazards.
    b. Own and implement Process Safety Management (PSM) elements:
    i. HAZOP/HAZID studies
    ii. Management of Change
    iii. Critical equipment integrity
    c. Ensure robust hazard identification and risk assessment principles embedded into daily operations on site
    d. Own and govern Permit-to-Work Systems
    e. Drive contractor safety management including pre-qualification, onboarding, field supervision, and performance monitoring
    f. Lead serious incident prevention, high potential near miss learning, and fatal risk control verification
    g. Drive Life-Saving Rules, behavioural safety, and leadership field safety programmes
    h. Ensure incidents are reported, investigated properly and identified improvement measures are completed on time
    i. Act as site authority during serious incidents and emergency situations
  2. Environmental Management & Sustainability
    a. Ensure compliance with all environmental permits and regulations
    b. Own the Environmental Management System (ISO 14001) and lead audits, gap closure, and regulatory inspections
    c. Develop and execute with support of relevant stakeholders’ waste minimisation, water reduction, and energy efficiency initiatives
    d. Lead environmental risk assessments and long-term site environmental liability management
  3. Occupational Health & Industrial Hygiene
    a. Establish and maintain a structured Occupational Health Management Programme focused on preventive concepts
    b. Ensure smooth coordination with occupational health physicians and service providers for entire life cycle of occupational health management (pre-employment, fatigue management programmes, contractor occupational health requirements, etc.)
    c. Lead programmes on chronic exposure risk management typical to sulphate TiO₂ operations
    d. Own the Industrial Hygiene strategy and monitoring programme, including exposure assessment and job exposure matrices, personal and area monitoring
    e. Ensure IH results are interpreted correctly, communicated transparently to leadership and workforce and translated into corrective engineering or operational improvements
  4. Landfill & Waste Management
    a. Full accountability for landfill strategy, design, operation, compliance and long-term stability
    b. Ensure safe-handling, storage, and disposal of:
    i. Red gypsum
    ii. Hazardous and non-hazardous waste
    c. Manage ground water monitoring, slope stability, and closure plans.
    d. Coordinate with engineering, operations, and external experts on landfill management
    e. Accountable for updated landfill documentation, mass balance, and regulatory reporting
  5. Quality Management System
    a. Act as the Management System Owner for all ISO certifications on site
    b. Ensure clear process mapping, risk-based thinking, and operational controls aligned with ISO requirements
    c. Plan and execute:
    i. Internal audits
    ii. External certification and surveillance audits
    iii. Management reviews with meaningful performance insights
    d. Ensure effective CAPA management, closure discipline, and verification of effectiveness
    e. Drive simplification and usability of procedures for shop-floor adoption
  6. Security & Site Risk Management
    a. Develop and implement site security strategy, including:
    i. Access control and contractor management
    ii. Material theft and sabotage prevention
    iii. Emergency response and crisis management
    b. Interface with local authorities for security, emergency preparedness, and mutual aid agreements
    c. Conduct periodic site risk assessments covering physical security and external threats
  7. Compliance, Audits and Governance
    a. Ensure compliance with local laws, permits, and corporate standards
    b. Lead internal and external audits (ISO, Halal, FAMI-QS, regulatory, customer, insurance)
    c. Ensure maintenance of EHSSQ documentation, procedures, and records
    d. Act as the site interface for regulators, auditors, insurers, and customers on EHSSQ matters
  8. EHS Digitalisation & Data Analytics
    a. Lead site-level EHS digital transformation ensuring EHSSQ systems are simple, user-centric and decision-oriented
    b. Ensure data quality, standardisation, and timely reporting
    c. Use analytics to identify systemic safety and health risks and trends
    d. Track, analyse, and improve leading and lagging safety indicators
  9. Leadership & Culture
    a. Coach line leaders to own safety and ISO systems, not delegate them to EHSSQ
    b. Lead safety leadership routines:
    i. Field safety walks
    ii. Safety interactions
    iii. Toolbox effectiveness reviews
    c. Build, coach, and develop the EHSSQ team competence in risk assessment, auditing, and investigation
    d. Influence line management to embed EHSSQ ownership into daily operations
    e. Lead EHSSQ governance forums, safety committees and quality management reviews
    f. Promote a “zero harm culture” with a risk-based approach

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Chemical, Environmental Engineering, Safety, or a related discipline
  • Post-graduate qualifications in Safety, Environment, or Quality Management preferred
  • 10–15+ years in EHSSQ roles within chemical or pigment manufacturing
  • Strong experience in the TiO₂ sulphate process or high-hazard chemical operations

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Proven expertise in landfill and waste management
  • Experience leading Integrated Quality Management Systems
  • Track record of regulatory engagement and audit leadership
  • Working knowledge of Process Safety Management (HAZOP/HAZID, Management of Change, critical equipment integrity) and Permit-to-Work Systems
  • Experience in Environmental Management Systems (ISO 14001), ISO certifications, and ISO, Halal and FAMI-QS audits
  • Experience in Occupational Health and Industrial Hygiene programmes, including exposure assessment and monitoring
  • Experience in CAPA management, incident investigation and emergency response
  • Experience in EHS digitalisation and data analytics, including leading and lagging safety indicators
  • Ability to analyse data and trends into strategic business alignment

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Building Teams: ability to build, coach and develop high-performing EHSSQ teams
  • Achieving Valuable Results: delivering measurable outcomes in safety, compliance and quality
  • Decision Making: sound judgement in serious incidents and emergency situations
  • Analytical Thinking: translating data and trends into insight and strategic direction
  • Organisational Perspective: aligning EHSSQ priorities with wider site and business objectives
  • Influencing: engaging leaders, regulators, auditors and contractors to embed EHSSQ ownership

job.title: Chief of Operation Officer -Hospitality
job.description:
FICO Corporation – Chief Operating Officer (COO)
Position
Chief Operating Officer (COO) – Hospitality
Reporting Line

  • Reports to: CEO / Owner
  • Acts as a key right-hand person to the owner on the hospitality portfolio.
  • Directly oversees and manages the General Managers across the hotel portfolio.

Business Scope

  • FICO has approximately 22 operating hotels in Thailand.
  • The COO will oversee hotel operations across the portfolio.
  • Responsible for managing the relationship with international hotel brands/operators, including Marriott and Hilton., manage 2 cluster GMs ( Mariott and Hilton)
  • Scope covers the business from top line to bottom line, including operational performance and P&L.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and oversee multiple Hotel GMs across the portfolio.
  • Drive overall hotel performance, revenue growth and profitability.
  • Take ownership of portfolio-level P&L performance.
  • Work closely with hotel owners and international hotel operators.
  • Oversee end-to-end hotel operations, from commercial/top-line performance through to bottom-line profitability.
  • Drive business growth and identify opportunities to improve hotel performance.
  • Manage and negotiate relationships/contracts with international hotel brands.
  • Ensure operational standards and financial targets are achieved across the portfolio.
  • Act as the owner's key operational partner and provide strategic recommendations.

Ideal Candidate Profile
Background

  • Senior hospitality executive with extensive multi-property experience.
  • Ideally 50+ years old, subject to experience and leadership maturity.
  • Previous experience as a Hotel General Manager, preferably in a large branded hotel.
  • Strong owner-side experience and comfortable working closely with hotel owners.
  • Experience acting as the owner's right-hand person is highly desirable.
  • Proven experience managing multiple hotels / cluster operations.

Brand Experience
Strong preference for candidates with experience in:

  • Hilton / Hilton Group
  • Marriott / Marriott International

Ideally, the candidate has managed cluster / multi-property operations, rather than only a single hotel.
Commercial & Financial Experience

  • Strong P&L ownership.
  • Proven track record of driving revenue and profitability.
  • Able to manage both top-line growth and bottom-line performance.
  • Strong understanding of hotel financials, operations and commercial strategy.
  • Experience managing owner/operator arrangements and hotel management contracts.

Potential Candidate Background
Priority talent pools:

  • Former / current Cluster GM – Hilton
  • Former / current Cluster GM – Marriott
  • Regional / Area VP Operations
  • Regional / Area Director of Operations
  • Multi-property Hotel GM
  • Senior hotel executives who have worked closely with owners/investors
  • Hospitality executives from hotel ownership/investment groups

Compensation

  • Budget: Approximately THB 500,000/month, with some flexibility depending on candidate profile.
  • Expatriate candidates: Open for consideration



Candidate Positioning

Introduction / Context
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation within the Industrial sector to hire an Application Engineer. This opportunity is based in Penang.
Position Overview
The Application Engineer is responsible for translating customer requirements into practical engineering solutions through technical proposal development, system concept design, and project engineering support.
This role plays a key part in ensuring solutions are technically feasible, commercially viable, and aligned with customer requirements and project objectives.
Key Responsibilities
• Understand customer technical requirements and translate them into engineering concepts and system solutions.

• Support project implementation activities including design review, system configuration, FAT/SAT preparation, and commissioning support where necessary.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Basic understanding of industrial automation systems, machinery, or manufacturing processes.

  • Proactive attitude with a willingness to learn in a fast-paced engineering environment.

Position Overview

Support the execution and continuous improvement of the organisation's Cyber Threat & Vulnerability Management (CTVM) programme through vulnerability assessment, threat monitoring, and remediation coordination.

Contribute to strengthening the organisation's cybersecurity posture by supporting risk reduction initiatives, security operations, compliance requirements, and enterprise resilience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist in planning, analysing, developing frameworks, and deploying the Cyber Threat & Vulnerability Management programme.
  • Support daily operations, including coordinating Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT) exercises with vendors, conducting internal and external vulnerability scans, prioritising findings, and tracking remediation activities.

  • Assist in identifying security vulnerabilities and supporting remediation through patching, configuration updates, code fixes, and infrastructure improvements.

  • Assist in developing policies, procedures, and operating models for cybersecurity and vulnerability management activities.
  • Support the monitoring and reporting of cybersecurity KPIs and KRIs through technical and management dashboards.
  • Provide technical support and security advisory services to stakeholders across the organisation.
  • Support security monitoring activities and coordinate remediation actions with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Stay current with emerging cybersecurity threats, vulnerabilities, attack techniques, and security trends.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline.
  • 1-3 years of experience within Cybersecurity, IT Security, Vulnerability Management, Security Operations Centre (SOC), or related domains.
  • Exposure to Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT), threat management, or security monitoring environments is advantageous.
  • Relevant professional certifications are an added advantage, including:
  • CEH
  • ITIL
  • CISA
  • EC-Council Certifications
  • Other security or vulnerability management certifications

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Basic understanding of IT infrastructure, networking, and cybersecurity principles.
  • Familiarity with vulnerability assessment, patch management, and security monitoring practices.
  • Experience with ticketing and workflow management platforms such as ServiceNow and Jira.
  • Exposure to security tools including:
  • Nessus Professional
  • CrowdStrike Falcon
  • Managed Detection & Response (MDR) solutions
  • Burp Suite
  • Identity Threat Protection (ITP)
  • Cloud-native security solutions (AWS preferred)
  • Understanding of cyber threat and vulnerability management processes.
  • Exposure to Security Operations Centre (SOC) environments.
  • Knowledge of penetration testing and cyber threat intelligence concepts.
  • Ability to support remediation tracking, vulnerability scanning, and security reporting activities.

job.title: Accounting Manager
job.description:
Job Title: Accounting Manager
Report to:

Location: Bangkok, Thailand


What The Duck (WTD) is a new-generation independent music label for music lovers and a community of talents who share the same passion for music.
Founded with the belief in creating an independent space for artists to express their creativity and develop their own unique sound, WTD embraces individuality, diversity, and doing things differently.
We believe in working together as partners, supporting one another’s ideas and creativity while continuing to grow in an ever-changing music industry.

Position Overview
We are looking for a hands-on and proactive Accounting Manager to build and strengthen our accounting function as the company grows.
You will oversee accounting operations while developing scalable systems, processes, and internal controls for a growing business. Beyond ensuring accurate and timely financial reporting, you will provide financial insights to management, work across teams to drive proper accounting practices, and build a strong and accountable accounting team.
This position will be primarily based at the WTD office, with occasional visits to partner offices or other locations for meetings, coordination, and business activities.

What You’ll Own
Accounting Operations & Financial Reporting

  • Oversee accounting operations, month-end/year-end closing, and timely preparation of accurate financial statements.
  • Ensure compliance with Thai Financial Reporting Standards (TFRS), tax regulations, and statutory requirements.
  • Maintain accurate accounting records, reconciliations, supporting documentation, and financial reports.
  • Establish and maintain clear accounting policies, procedures, and approval processes.
  • Prepare budgets, forecasts, and financial analysis to support management decision-making.

Accounting Systems, Processes & Internal Controls

  • Build and continuously improve scalable accounting systems, processes, and internal controls suitable for a growing medium-sized business.
  • Identify process gaps, inefficiencies, and risks, and implement practical improvements.
  • Work across departments to ensure accounting procedures and controls are understood and followed.
  • Guide and influence stakeholders to adopt proper accounting practices while balancing compliance with practical business needs.

Audit, Tax & Compliance

  • Serve as the primary accounting contact for external auditors, coordinating audit schedules, documentation, and responses to audit inquiries.
  • Work with auditors to resolve accounting issues and implement recommendations where appropriate.
  • Coordinate and communicate with the Thai Revenue Department and other relevant authorities regarding tax matters, inspections, inquiries, and required documentation.
  • Ensure timely and accurate preparation and submission of tax filings and statutory reports.
  • Proactively identify accounting, tax, and compliance risks and recommend appropriate corrective actions.

Cross-Functional & Business Partnership

  • Partner with management and cross-functional teams on accounting, budgeting, and financial matters.
  • Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to ensure accurate information, proper documentation, and compliance with company procedures.
  • Communicate financial and accounting requirements clearly to non-finance stakeholders and influence teams to follow appropriate processes.
  • Provide financial analysis and practical insights to support management decision-making.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Build, lead, and develop a strong accounting team that can support the company’s growth.
  • Establish clear responsibilities, standards, and accountability within the team.
  • Coach and develop team members while fostering ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement.


Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or a related field; CPA is a plus.
  • 5–7 years of accounting experience, including at least 2 years in a managerial or supervisory role.
  • Strong audit background preferred; Big 4 experience is a plus.
  • Proven experience building or improving accounting systems, processes, and internal controls, ideally within a small to medium-sized or fast-growing business.
  • Strong knowledge of TFRS, Thai taxation, statutory compliance, and financial reporting.
  • Hands-on experience in budgeting, cash flow management, financial analysis, and month-end/year-end closing.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Strong leadership, communication, and influencing skills, with the ability to gain buy-in and work effectively across teams.
  • Proactive, adaptable, hands-on, and comfortable in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
  • Open-minded and willing to challenge existing ways of working to drive meaningful improvements.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel and accounting/ERP systems.
  • Good command of written and spoken English.
  • Passionate about music and excited to contribute to the entertainment industry.

job.title: Senior Channel Planning Specialist
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Information Technology industry to hire a Senior Channel Planning Specialist. This opportunity is based in Malaysia. The organisation is seeking a commercially driven professional to lead channel planning initiatives, optimise incentive frameworks, and drive sustainable subscriber growth through strategic channel development and performance management.

Position Overview

Lead the development and optimisation of channel income models, incentive programmes, and tactical initiatives to drive channel growth and competitiveness.
Play a pivotal role in shaping channel strategy, improving business performance, and delivering sustainable commercial outcomes across the organisation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Team lead in overseeing the development, execution, & dispute management of the Open Channel income model, pioneering work into placing effective drivers to acquire Malaysian subscribers & growing a solid Postpaid base. Facilitating change management in the long-term sustainability of channel’s future landscape and drive the development of futureproof infrastructure in line with corporate KPIs.
  • Designing & validating the components, business rules, and reward structure that will secure a solid productive dealer base to deliver Malaysian Prepaid & Postpaid subscriber acquisition, ensure competitiveness in market & having regular review of payouts to ensure a sustainable operating cost and investment.
  • Support in setting the right landscape for the channel aligned to the company/ CEO priorities, striving to deliver productive touch point growth & optimal product mix (primarily driven by Prepaid, will also include Postpaid, Fibre, and/or Convergence) in tandem with delivering sustainable operating cost that will collectively push the channel forwards.
  • Team lead in overseeing the development & maintenance of the Prepaid base incentive scheme for the company, ensuring competitiveness in market and driving the channel forward.
  • Timely review & setup of incentives for new or refined Prepaid product offers, ensure competitiveness in market having regular review of incentive payouts to ensure a sustainable operating cost and investment.
  • Regular engagement with stakeholders managing Postpaid base incentive touching Open Channel, ensuring competitiveness and relevancy for the channel.
  • Responsible for the end-to-end delivery of assigned tactical/ campaigns and activities in a cohesive, organised, and well-orchestrated manner, including but not limited to, budgets, planning, processes, deliverable, collaterals, and communications, as well as all necessary coordination and engagements with multiple stakeholders within the company, including but not limited to, marketing, product, sales, distribution, dealer management, operations, performance management, legal, system & IT, corporate communications, and finance.
  • Take ownership with regular monitoring of the channel overall performance to track progress of channel initiatives and actual vs company target.
  • Capable of critical assessment via data/ report processing to identify gaps, initiate and plan proposals for necessity interventions to deliver to the company objective & target.
  • Budget/ A&P/ Spend management & post-evaluation for assigned channel initiative to review on ROI.
  • Regular check & balance of initiative, as well as occasional on-ground audit to ensure executional and operational excellence.
  • Able to independently manage relevant senior or operational stakeholders as and when necessary.
  • Able to work independently or collectively with team members to develop proposals or data sets.
  • Lead/ Facilitate presentations or forum discussions with internal or external stakeholders to acquire approval or guidance.
  • Lead briefings to Region & Sales Force for assigned channel initiatives.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in commerce-related fields (e.g., Economics, Marketing, Accounting, Business, Finance) or equivalent.
  • 8–12 years of relevant working experience.
  • Proven track record of consistently delivering strong business results against stretch objectives.
  • Demonstrated accountability and ownership, whether as an individual contributor, team member, team leader, or through influential leadership.
  • Strong ability to collaborate effectively, both within the function and across cross-functional teams.
  • Strong and effective communicator, both formal and informal, with the ability to coordinate across multiple stakeholder groups and levels through clear, concise, and unambiguous communication.
  • Strong data analytical skills with the ability to derive actionable insights from large datasets (proficiency in MS Excel, SAP, Power BI).
  • Experience in on-ground sales and trade, leveraging practical knowledge to develop and execute operationally relevant plans; added advantage.

job.title: Finance Director
job.description:
Finance Director / CFO – Thailand


  • Location: Based in Chonburi (Factory) with regular presence in Bangkok (Commercial Office)

  • Industry: Industrial Manufacturing / Fluid Control Systems

  • Reporting Line: Managing Director (Expat) & CEO (Expat)

  • Team Scope: 4 Subordinates in Finance & Accounting (including 1 Manager)

  • Language Requirement: Native/Fluent Thai with Business-Fluent English (Must-Have)

The Opportunity

Are you an executive financial leader ready to partner directly with C-level expat leadership to drive financial excellence across both manufacturing operations and commercial growth in Thailand?

Ebro Valve Thailand is a global leader in high-performance industrial valves and actuation systems. As we continue to strengthen our manufacturing presence and commercial footprint in Southeast Asia, we are seeking a dynamic, commercially minded Finance Director / Chief Financial Officer (CFO) to lead our local financial operations.

Based primarily at our state-of-the-art manufacturing plant in Chonburi, with continuous oversight of our Bangkok commercial sales office, you will serve as the strategic financial co-pilot to the Expat Managing Director and CEO. You will oversee a finance and accounting team of 4 professionals (including 1 Finance Manager), ensuring rigorous financial governance, plant cost optimization, working capital management, and strategic commercial decision support.

Key Responsibilities


  • Executive Strategic Partnership: Serve as the trusted financial advisor to the Expat MD and CEO, providing data-backed insights, commercial financial modeling, and risk evaluations to drive strategic country objectives.

  • Plant & Commercial Financial Control: Exercise complete financial oversight covering plant operations (manufacturing cost accounting, inventory, CapEx, variances) in Chonburi and commercial activities (pricing margins, credit control, sales performance) in Bangkok.

job.title: Payroll Executive (Penang)
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Healthcare industry to hire a Payroll Executive. This opportunity is based in Malaysia. The organisation is seeking a detail-oriented payroll professional to manage end-to-end payroll administration, ensure statutory compliance, and support accurate payroll operations within a confidential and controlled environment.

Position Overview

Manage the accurate and timely administration of monthly payroll operations while ensuring compliance with Malaysian statutory requirements and internal controls.
Support organisational efficiency by delivering reliable payroll services, maintaining data integrity, and providing effective payroll-related support to employees and stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

1. Payroll Administration

  • Coordinate the monthly payroll process with the appointed payroll service provider.
  • Prepare and submit approved payroll inputs, including employee movements, salary changes, allowances, deductions, overtime, attendance and leave.
  • Ensure Employee Change Requests (ECR) and other approved changes are accurately reflected in payroll.
  • Review payroll reports and calculations before final payroll approval.
  • Ensure payroll inputs and approvals are completed within the agreed payroll timeline.
  • Maintain payroll checklists and supporting documentation.
  • Support payroll year-end activities and required payroll reporting.

2. Time & Attendance and Overtime

  • Work with the Administration Support to ensure attendance, overtime and leave records in CentralHR are complete and accurate before payroll processing.
  • Review payroll-impacting attendance and overtime information.
  • Follow up with Team Leaders and managers on outstanding approvals.
  • Verify overtime calculations against approved company policies and requirements.
  • Investigate discrepancies between attendance records and payroll outputs.

3. Payroll Service Provider

  • Act as the primary HR contact for the appointed payroll service provider.
  • Provide required payroll information and supporting documents within agreed timelines.
  • Review payroll outputs and raise discrepancies for correction.
  • Coordinate payroll adjustments and follow up until issues are resolved.
  • Monitor adherence to agreed payroll timelines and service requirements.
  • Maintain records of key payroll submissions, approvals and communications.

4. Statutory Compliance

  • Coordinate with the payroll service provider to ensure accurate processing of EPF, SOCSO, EIS, PCB/MTD and other applicable statutory deductions and contributions.
  • Review statutory reports and calculations for accuracy.
  • Support statutory submissions, reconciliations, audits and inspections.
  • Monitor changes to Malaysian payroll legislation and highlight relevant requirements to the HR Manager.

5. Payroll Reconciliation & Controls

  • Reconcile payroll against approved employee movements, attendance, overtime and HR records.
  • Investigate and resolve payroll variances before payroll finalisation.
  • Maintain appropriate payroll controls to minimise errors.
  • Identify recurring payroll issues and recommend process improvements.

6. Claims Administration

  • Verify employee dental, optical and miscellaneous claims against supporting documents and company policy.
  • Ensure approved claims are processed within the required timeline.
  • Follow up on incomplete or discrepant claims with employees or approvers.
  • Maintain appropriate claims records for reconciliation and audit purposes.

7. Employee Payroll Support

  • Respond to employee enquiries relating to salary, payslips, overtime, allowances, deductions, claims and statutory contributions.
  • Explain payroll processes and provide appropriate guidance to employees.
  • Investigate payroll-related concerns and coordinate with the payroll service provider where required.
  • Escalate complex or sensitive matters to the HR Manager.
  • Maintain confidentiality when handling employee payroll information.

8. Payroll Systems & Data

  • Maintain accurate payroll-related employee data in CentralHR and other relevant systems.
  • Update approved changes to salary, position, department, employment status, bank details and other payroll-impacting information.
  • Conduct periodic checks to ensure payroll and HR system data remain aligned.
  • Support payroll system testing, enhancements and troubleshooting.
  • Liaise with system providers on payroll-related technical issues when required.

9. Finance Support & Reporting

  • Provide Finance with payroll reports and information required for payroll reconciliation and financial reporting.
  • Support reconciliation of payroll costs against approved employee movements and payroll records.
  • Assist with payroll accruals, variance analysis and other payroll-related Finance requirements.
  • Prepare payroll reports and summaries required by the HR Manager and Finance.

10. Records & Confidentiality

  • Maintain accurate and confidential payroll records.
  • Ensure payroll documents, statutory records, approvals and supporting documentation are properly filed and retained.
  • Ensure payroll and employee information is accessible only to authorised personnel.
  • Handle salary, bank, statutory and personal employee information in accordance with company confidentiality and data protection requirements.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Diploma or Degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Accounting or a related discipline.
  • 5–10 years of experience in payroll administration, HR administration or a similar role.
  • Hands-on experience with monthly payroll processing and reconciliation.
  • Experience with HRIS/HR portals and Time & Attendance systems.
  • Working knowledge of Malaysian statutory payroll requirements.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • End-to-end monthly payroll processing and payroll reconciliation.
  • Experience working with payroll service providers and managing payroll submissions.
  • Knowledge of Malaysian statutory payroll requirements, including EPF, SOCSO, EIS and PCB/MTD.
  • Experience with HRIS/HR portals and Time & Attendance systems.
  • Payroll reporting, payroll controls and payroll variance analysis.
  • Payroll system testing, enhancements and troubleshooting.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and HR/payroll systems.
  • Claims administration and payroll-related record management.
  • Payroll data management and maintenance of employee records within HR systems.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Good numerical and analytical skills.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines.
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
  • Good problem-solving and follow-through skills.
  • Ability to work independently and coordinate effectively with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Demonstrates ownership and the ability to manage payroll activities with minimal supervision.

job.title: Financial Controller
job.description:
Job Description

Position Title Financial Controller

Job Level Manager

Division Finance

Reporting to Chief Financial Officer

Job Purpose
Summarize the role / objective of the job Financial Controller is responsible for leading the Company's accounting function and ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and timeliness of financial reporting. This role oversees all accounting operations, statutory compliance, tax coordination, audit management, and internal controls while ensuring adherence to applicable accounting standards, group’s requirement and regulatory requirements.
Financial Controller serves as a key advisor to CFO and senior management by providing financial insights, strengthening governance, and driving continuous improvement across accounting processes and systems.

Key Responsibilities
Detail the essential job duties and job responsibilities Leadership and Management:

  • Lead, develop, and manage the Accounting function, fostering a high-performance culture through effective coaching, talent development, and performance management.
  • Provide strategic leadership and direction to the accounting team to ensure integrity, operational excellence, service quality, and continuous improvement.
  • Oversee day-to-day accounting operations, ensuring efficient workflows, strong governance, and adherence to established policies and procedures.
  • Partner closely with CFO, business leaders, and regional finance teams to align accounting operations with organizational objectives and strategic priorities.
  • Develop and implement accounting policies, procedures, and controls to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry standards.

Financial Reporting:

  • Ensure the timely and accurate preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with TFRS, IFRS, Group accounting policies, and regulatory requirements.
  • Provide insightful financial analysis, variance reporting, and commentary to support management decision-making and business performance improvement.
  • Manage the closing of local and group reporting monthly accounts, ensuring financial and management reporting is completed timely and accurately.
  • Coordinate and oversee external audit processes, liaising with auditors and addressing any issues or concerns to ensure smooth audit completion.
  • Oversee financial reporting submissions to regulatory authorities, including Office of Insurance Commission (OIC), tax authorities, and other governing bodies.

Compliance and Risk Management:

  • Ensure compliance with TFRS, IFRS, group and local accounting policies, as well as all other applicable regulations and standards.
  • Establish, maintain, and continuously enhance a robust internal control framework to safeguard company assets and ensure the integrity of financial reporting.
  • Monitor developments in accounting standards, regulatory requirements, and industry practices, ensuring timely adoption and compliance.
  • Promote the highest standards of professional ethics, transparency, and corporate governance within the finance function and across the organization.

Strategic and Business Partnership:

  • Act as a trusted business partner to senior management by providing financial expertise, analysis, and recommendations to support strategic initiatives and key business decisions.
  • Work closely in the development of the company’s annual budget and financial forecasts.
  • Support business growth initiatives, transformation projects, and operational improvement programs from a financial and accounting perspective.

Systems, Process Improvement & Transformation:

  • Oversee accounting systems and financial reporting platforms to ensure data integrity, operational efficiency, and compliance with business requirements.
  • Lead initiatives to streamline accounting processes, improve controls, and enhance reporting capabilities through automation and digital transformation.
  • Evaluate and implement process improvements that increase productivity, reduce risk, and improve data quality.
  • Promote the use of technology, analytics, and best practices to improve financial management and decision support.

Skills & Competencies
Specific knowledge and skills that relate to successful performance in the job

  • Decision Making & Problem Solving
  • Strategic Planning & Organizational skills
  • Financial Expertise & Knowledge of Regulatory Compliance
  • Leadership & People Development
  • Stakeholder and Change Management
  • Integrity & Professional Ethics

Qualifications
Field of study and experiences

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting; CPA preferred.
  • 10 years of proven experience in accounting or finance roles, with minimum 5 years in a leadership role managing accounting and financial reporting functions.
  • Strong knowledge of TFRS and IFRS and internal controls, especially IFRS 17.
  • Experience in insurance or other regulated financial industries preferred.
  • Experience working with ERP systems and finance transformation initiatives.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to interact effectively with senior management, external auditors, and other stakeholders.
  • Good command of both spoken and written English.

(for recruitment purposes only)

This role will support manufacturing sites in the Philippines and Taiwan, as well as the regional supplier network. As an individual contributor, the position will work closely with Strategic Sourcing, Supply Planning, Site Logistics, Finance, Supplier Quality Assurance, Quality and Food Safety, Research and Development, and other cross-functional teams to ensure supply continuity, supplier readiness, operational stability, and value delivery. The role will focus on translating sourcing strategies into operational execution, while supporting supplier qualification, risk management, and cost-saving initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage day-to-day commercial relationships with regional suppliers to ensure reliable service, strong supplier performance, and value delivery.
  • Coordinate operational requirements, including lead times, minimum order quantities, supply allocations, and service levels.
  • Monitor supplier capacity, inventory pipelines, stock positions, lead times, and emerging market risks to identify potential supply disruptions.
  • Collaborate with Supply Planning and Site Logistics teams to prevent material shortages, coordinate supply allocations, and implement recovery plans when supply is constrained.
  • Coordinate supply continuity and resilience initiatives, including dual sourcing, safety stock, alternative supplier qualification, and supplier business continuity planning.
  • Resolve supplier disputes, service failures, and non-conformance issues, escalating significant commercial risks and recurring performance concerns as needed.
  • Identify and coordinate cost-saving, cost-avoidance, and value-engineering opportunities across inventory, logistics, minimum order quantities, and supplier operations.
  • Support supplier onboarding and material qualification for innovation, quality, sustainability, resilience, and value improvement initiatives.
  • Work closely with Supplier Quality Assurance, R&D, Quality and Food Safety, Supply, Strategic Sourcing, and manufacturing sites to complete supplier screening, validation, and readiness activities.
  • Facilitate supplier reviews, project meetings, crisis response, and business continuity planning, ensuring clear tracking of milestones, risks, decisions, and action items.
  • Provide commercial inputs for budgets, forecasts, and cost reviews, highlighting supplier or market developments that may affect costs and supply continuity.
  • Support supplier development and continuous improvement initiatives to strengthen supplier capabilities, responsiveness, governance, and operational discipline.

Job Specifications/Qualifications

  • Education & Professional Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Procurement, Business, Operations Management, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Knowledge/Experience: 3–5 years of experience in Procurement, Commercial Operations, Supplier Management, Supply Chain, or a related field, preferably within a manufacturing or fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG) environment.
  • Experience managing supplier relationships and supporting commercial operations in a manufacturing environment.
  • Working knowledge of procurement practices, quality systems, material qualification, inventory management, and business continuity planning.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams in regional or global environments.
  • Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities independently and with limited supervision.

job.title: Senior Service Readiness Specialist
job.description:

Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with a leading organisation in the Consumer industry to hire a Senior Service Readiness Specialist. This opportunity is based in Johor, Malaysia.
Position Overview
Lead global service readiness activities for new product introductions and major product changes, ensuring products are fully prepared for service deployment at launch and throughout their lifecycle.
Drive cross-functional alignment, governance, and operational readiness to ensure products are serviceable, supportable, and scalable across global markets from Day One.
Key Responsibilities
Service Readiness Leadership

  • Lead end-to-end service readiness activities for new product introductions and significant product changes.
  • Define, maintain, and govern service readiness plans, milestones, deliverables, and success criteria.
  • Ensure all service readiness requirements are achieved before product launch and market deployment.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for service readiness across cross-functional programmes.

New Product Introduction (NPI) Support

  • Partner with Product Development, Manufacturing, and Service Design teams throughout the development lifecycle.
  • Ensure service requirements are represented during product development, validation, and launch planning activities.
  • Support Design for Serviceability (DfS) objectives by identifying service risks and opportunities early in development.
  • Drive readiness reviews and formal service sign-off processes prior to launch.

Service Operations Readiness

  • Coordinate readiness of:
  • Service parts and assemblies
  • Repair procedures and service manuals
  • Technical documentation
  • Diagnostic tools and software
  • Service tooling and equipment
  • Service training materials
  • Customer support knowledge content
  • Ensure readiness deliverables are aligned with global and regional service requirements.

Risk Management & Governance

  • Identify, assess, and mitigate service readiness risks and launch blockers.
  • Maintain readiness dashboards, programme trackers, and executive reporting.
  • Escalate issues, dependencies, and resource constraints to programme leadership.
  • Drive resolution of readiness gaps through cross-functional action plans.

Cross-Functional Stakeholder Management

  • Build strong partnerships across:
  • Product Engineering
  • Manufacturing Engineering
  • Supply Chain
  • Procurement
  • Quality & Reliability
  • Customer Service
  • Refurbishment Operations
  • Regional Market Teams
  • Facilitate readiness reviews, launch forums, and programme governance meetings.

Service Readiness Process Excellence

  • Develop and continuously improve service readiness methodologies, templates, and governance frameworks.
  • Drive standardisation of readiness processes across categories, regions, and delivery teams.
  • Support digitalisation initiatives that improve readiness visibility, reporting, and execution efficiency.
  • Promote best practice sharing across the global service organisation.

Post-Launch Support

  • Monitor service readiness performance following launch.
  • Analyse launch issues, field feedback, and service performance metrics.
  • Lead lessons-learned reviews and implement corrective actions to improve future launches.
  • Support major sustaining engineering changes that require service readiness activities.

Key Requirements
Qualifications & Experience

  • Experience in service readiness, service engineering, aftersales operations, product support, NPI, or manufacturing engineering.
  • Experience leading complex cross-functional programmes within engineering or manufacturing environments.
  • Experience supporting product launches and lifecycle management activities.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders and programme deliverables simultaneously.
  • Experience managing risks, dependencies, and readiness milestones in fast-paced environments.
  • Consumer electronics, appliance, automotive, medical device, or advanced manufacturing experience.
  • Experience working with JDM partners, ODMs, or global manufacturing environments.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Experience with service parts management, MPLs, BOMs, or product configuration management.

  • Exposure to Design for Serviceability (DfS) or service design methodologies.
  • Strong programme and project management skills.
  • Risk identification and mitigation expertise.
  • Data-driven decision making and analytical problem solving.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Excellent stakeholder influencing and communication abilities.
  • Strategic thinker with strong operational execution capability.
  • Ability to operate effectively across global and multicultural teams.
  • Strong organisational and prioritisation skills.
  • Proven ability to lead cross-functional collaboration and governance activities across diverse stakeholder groups.

job.title: [CONFIDENTIAL] Service Manager (Medical Equipment)
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Healthcare industry to hire a Technical Manager. This opportunity is based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. The organisation is seeking an experienced technical leader to oversee technical service operations, ensure equipment reliability, and deliver exceptional customer support while maintaining compliance with industry regulations.

Position Overview

Lead the technical service function to ensure the efficient installation, maintenance and repair of medical aesthetic equipment across the organisation.
Drive service excellence, regulatory compliance and team performance to support customer satisfaction and business growth.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead, supervise and develop the technical service team, including work allocation, performance reviews, coaching and training.
• Plan and oversee installation, preventive maintenance, calibration, laser alignment and repair activities.
• Manage service schedules and manpower allocation to ensure timely completion of jobs and effective response to equipment breakdowns.
• Provide technical guidance to the team and hands-on support for complex troubleshooting, urgent repairs and escalated customer issues.
• Monitor service quality, response times, recurring equipment faults and customer feedback, and implement improvements.
• Oversee spare parts inventory, warranty claims and the return of defective parts to manufacturers.
• Coordinate with manufacturers on technical issues, product complaints, service procedures and team training.
• Oversee equipment setup and technical support for demonstrations, exhibitions and new installations.
• Manage maintenance service contracts and ensure accurate quotations, service records and administrative documentation.
• Ensure technical matters are properly documented, communicated, tracked and followed through to resolution.
• Review technical service reports and maintain complete equipment maintenance records.
• Ensure all technical activities follow GDPMD guidelines, manufacturer specifications and applicable safety procedures.
• Coordinate with sales, logistics and other departments on equipment delivery, installation and after-sales support.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

• Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical, Electronic or Mechanical Engineering, or an equivalent qualification.
• At least 5 years of relevant technical service experience, including maintenance and troubleshooting of medical laser or medical aesthetic equipment.
• Experience supervising or leading a technical service team.

Technical / Functional Expertise

• Maintenance and troubleshooting of medical laser or medical aesthetic equipment.
• Strong technical problem-solving skills, with the ability to guide the team through complex troubleshooting and repairs.
• Good planning and organisational skills, including managing service schedules, manpower and spare parts.
• Knowledge of GDPMD requirements and their application to technical service operations.
• Able to communicate effectively with customers, manufacturers and internal stakeholders, and prepare clear technical reports in English.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

• Strong leadership, coaching and interpersonal skills, with a customer-focused approach.
• Able to work independently, prioritise urgent issues and ensure the team completes work within agreed timelines.
• Experience supervising or leading a technical service team.
• Possess a valid driving licence and be willing to travel for customer visits and urgent technical support when required.

Associate Director, Customer Service Excellence leads the transformation of AIA Thailand’s customer service operations — modernizing contact center and non-voice channels, elevating workforce capability, and embedding service governance and quality excellence. Operational Excellence & Service Transformation (20%)

Technology & Operational Intelligence Enablement (20%)

  • Demonstrated track record in operational transformation, service modernization, or customer experience improvement initiatives
  • Experience managing large-scale frontline operations with mixed workforce models (permanent, outsource, contract)

job.title: SQA Specialist
job.description:
Supplier Quality Assurance Specialist
Monroe Consulting Group is an executive search firm recruiting on behalf of a leading multinational FMCG company. Our client is seeking a Supplier Quality Assurance (SQA) Specialist who will be responsible for ensuring the quality, safety, and compliance of raw materials and packaging materials through supplier assessment, quality risk management, corrective action, and continuous improvement initiatives. The role will work closely with suppliers and cross-functional teams across the region to maintain and improve material quality in line with global Quality and Food Safety standards. This is a hybrid role based in Antipolo City, with travel as required.
Key Responsibilities
Supplier Assessment & Development

  • Conduct onsite and remote supplier assessments and audits, and follow up on corrective actions.
  • Review supplier audit reports and verify the effectiveness of supplier quality controls.
  • Assess and support supplier capability to consistently meet quality and food safety requirements.
  • Monitor supplier quality performance and implement supplier development initiatives.

Continuous Improvement & Quality Management

  • Identify and manage quality risks arising from supplier audits, non-conformances, and material issues.
  • Initiate and drive corrective and preventive actions with both internal stakeholders and suppliers.
  • Monitor supplier performance and identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Provide Quality and Food Safety insights to support supply strategy and material quality management.

Non-Conformance Management

  • Manage supplier-related quality issues and material non-conformances.
  • Lead investigations into material incidents, including root cause analysis and corrective action.
  • Follow up on corrective and preventive actions to ensure timely and effective resolution.
  • Communicate quality issues, investigation results, and action plans to relevant internal stakeholders.

Quality & Food Safety Risk Assessment

  • Assess the quality and food safety risks associated with new and existing raw materials and packaging materials.
  • Evaluate microbiological, chemical, and physical risks and ensure appropriate controls are reflected in material specifications.
  • Review and understand supplier controls for identified quality and food safety risks.
  • Partner with Procurement/Buying teams and suppliers to ensure material risk assessments and specifications are reviewed, understood, and agreed upon.

Key Stakeholders & Scope

  • Work closely with Quality & Food Safety, Supply Chain, Procurement, R&D, Commercial, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Support supplier onboarding and approval for new product development, supply resilience, commercial initiatives, and cost optimization projects.
  • Assess, approve, verify, and develop supplier capabilities to meet required specifications for incoming materials.
  • Investigate and follow up on raw material and packaging non-conformances across regional sites.
  • Develop strong technical knowledge of different material categories and contribute to regional quality initiatives.
  • Collaborate with suppliers and internal stakeholders across different countries, cultures, and time zones.
  • Provide technical input and recommendations based on HACCP, prerequisite programs (PRPs), Quality Management Systems, and category-specific food safety requirements.
  • Identify quality risks, define appropriate corrective and preventive actions, and ensure effective root cause investigations.
  • Participate in regional and global quality initiatives and knowledge-sharing activities.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Food Technology, Chemistry, Biology, Engineering, or a related scientific field.
  • 3–7 years of relevant experience in Supplier Quality Assurance, Quality & Food Safety, Manufacturing, R&D, Quality Systems, Laboratory Management, or Engineering, preferably within the food/FMCG industry.
  • Sound understanding of food safety principles, HACCP, Quality Management Systems, and material quality management.
  • Experience in supplier auditing, assessment, quality management, or supplier development is highly preferred.
  • FSSC/food safety lead auditor certification is an advantage.
  • Knowledge of different food manufacturing technologies and material categories.
  • Good understanding of applicable Quality, Food Safety, and material quality standards and regulations.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and root cause investigation skills.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Proactive, collaborative, and results-oriented with the ability to work independently.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
  • Willingness to travel locally and internationally as required.
  • Willing to work in a hybrid setup based in Antipolo City.
