job.title: Free Trade Supervisor
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group is recruiting on behalf of a leading manufacturing enterprise. We are seeking a high-caliber Free Zone & Trade Compliance Specialist to oversee daily Free Zone operations, guarantee 100% customs compliance, and optimize import-export workflows. Reporting directly to management, this role acts as the primary gatekeeper for asset movements, stock integrity, and statutory audit readiness across our Free Zone facility. The Free Zone & Trade Compliance Specialist is responsible for directing daily operational workflows within the Free Zone to ensure full compliance with customs legislation, accurate inventory tracking, and seamless Import–Export activities.
  • Direct and monitor all material movements into, within, and out of the Free Zone (raw materials, finished goods, machinery, and capital assets).
  • Perform thorough verification of Import–Export declarations, shipping documents, and customs clearance paperwork for zero errors.
  • Maintain HS Code classifications, duty exemption privileges, and tariff database integrity in system records.
  • Conduct periodic physical stock reconciliations against Free Zone system balances to ensure full asset accountability.
  • Investigate stock discrepancies, identify root causes, and implement preventive/corrective actions.
  • Compile and organize documentation for official Customs Audits, Revenue Department reviews, and Internal Audits.
  • Investigate stock discrepancies, identify root causes, and implement preventive/corrective actions.
  • Compile and organize documentation for official Customs Audits, Revenue Department reviews, and Internal Audits.
  • Act as the primary liaison with the Thai Customs Department, licensed Customs Brokers, Shipping Agents, and Freight Forwarders.
  • Author, review, and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and Work Instructions (WIs) regarding Free Zone compliance.
  • Assign tasks, monitor performance metrics, and mentor operational team members.

 

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Document Accuracy: Zero discrepancies in customs documentation and regulatory filings.
  • Stock Precision: High accuracy rate between physical stock/assets and Free Zone ERP balances.
  • Audit Performance: Zero penalty findings or major non-conformities during Customs & Internal Audits.
  • Operational Flow: Timely clearance of inbound/outbound shipments without customs delays.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, International Business, Supply Chain, or related field.
  • Experienced in Free Zone management, customs clearance, or international trade compliance.
  • Strong problem-solving abilities, analytical mindset for inventory data, and structured coordination skills.
  • Advanced skills in MS Office (Excel) and operational proficiency in ERP (SAP/Oracle) and WMS platforms.
  • Professional English proficiency (written and spoken.

job.title: Head of IT Operations and Infrastructure Management
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with a leading organisation in the Information Technology sector to hire a Head of IT Operations & Infrastructure Management. This opportunity is based in Kuching, Sarawak, Malaysia.

Position Overview

Lead the strategy, governance, and operational management of the organisation's IT infrastructure, ensuring secure, scalable, and highly available technology services.

Drive infrastructure modernisation, operational excellence, and technology resilience to support critical business operations and future growth.

Key Responsibilities

IT Infrastructure Strategy & Governance

  • Develop and execute the IT infrastructure roadmap, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
  • Establish governance frameworks for IT operations, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Define and enforce best practices for infrastructure management, cloud computing, disaster recovery, and operational resilience.
  • Drive infrastructure transformation initiatives to support organisational growth and digital enablement.

Network & Cloud Management

  • Oversee the design, implementation, and optimisation of enterprise network architecture.
  • Manage cloud infrastructure environments, ensuring scalability, security, and cost efficiency.
  • Ensure high availability, reliability, and performance of IT systems and services.
  • Lead data centre operations, including storage, backup, recovery, and business continuity capabilities.

IT Service Management & Operations

  • Implement IT service management best practices to support efficient and reliable operations.
  • Monitor infrastructure and system performance, identifying optimisation opportunities and operational improvements.
  • Ensure timely resolution of incidents and service disruptions while minimising business impact.
  • Lead technology change and release management activities to ensure smooth implementation of new solutions.

Vendor & Stakeholder Management

  • Manage relationships with technology vendors, service providers, and key partners.
  • Oversee procurement activities, contract management, and service level performance.
  • Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to ensure infrastructure services support organisational priorities.
  • Monitor vendor performance and ensure compliance with contractual obligations.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing infrastructure and operations team.
  • Provide technical leadership across infrastructure architecture, cloud services, operations, and technology governance.
  • Foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and operational excellence.
  • Support professional development and capability-building initiatives across the team.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum 15 years of experience in IT Infrastructure, IT Operations, Cloud Services, or Technology Management roles.
  • Proven experience leading large-scale infrastructure environments and enterprise technology operations.
  • Strong experience managing technology vendors, commercial agreements, and outsourced service providers.
  • Demonstrated success delivering complex technology initiatives within business-critical environments.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Strong expertise in enterprise infrastructure management, network architecture, and cloud computing.
  • Experience managing data centres, backup and recovery solutions, and business continuity programmes.
  • Strong knowledge of SQL Server, database management, and enterprise infrastructure technologies.
  • Experience implementing IT Service Management (ITSM) frameworks and operational governance practices.

job.title: Trade Partnerships Manager (BD Manager)
job.description:
Trade Partnerships Manager

  • Industry: Business Advisory / Trade & Market Access Solutions
  • Location: Bangkok, Thailand (Monday – Friday, Standard Business Hours)
  • Monthly Base Salary:
  • Manager Level: THB 55,000 – 80,000
  • Senior Manager Level: Up to THB 120,000 (commensurate with 5–8+ years of relevant experience)
  • Total Compensation Package: Basic Salary + 1-Month AWS + Performance Bonus

The Opportunity
Are you an accomplished partnership builder and strategic facilitator skilled in bridging international enterprises with local market ecosystems?
Our client is a premier Business Advisory organization dedicated to enabling cross-border commercial growth, international trade facilitation, and market entry strategy. We are seeking a high-caliber Strategic Partnerships & Ecosystem Manager to act as the primary catalyst for Asia-based enterprises establishing and scaling their commercial footprint in Thailand.
Note: This is not a direct sales, cold-calling, lead generation, or commission/target-driven commercial role. This strategic facilitation mandate is focused on high-level stakeholder engagement, public-private collaboration, and structuring meaningful, long-term partnerships from exploration through to successful implementation.
Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the strategic bridge for the new companies across Asia expanding into Thailand, identifying collaboration opportunities and connecting them with credible local partners, joint ventures, and enterprise clients.
  • and maintain strong relationships with government agencies, trade bodies, chambers of commerce, and industry associations across Thailand and the region.
  • Map local industry ecosystems, understand multi-party commercial objectives, identify mutual strategic interests, and facilitate bilateral cooperation agreements.
  • Steer partnership initiatives from initial matchmaking and high-level stakeholder dialogue through to formal execution and practical project implementation.
  • Engage comfortably with C-suite executives, senior government officials, and key community leaders, delivering market insights and strategic alignment.

Key Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, International Relations, Economics, or related disciplines.
  • Professional Experience:
  • Years of experience in partnership management, business advisory, market entry consulting, or stakeholder relations.
  • Advantage point to a proven leadership in cross-border alliances, public-private partnerships, or ecosystem building.
  • Demonstrated capability in Business-to-Government (B2G) relations, trade associations/chambers engagement, public-private sector collaboration, and strategic partnership lifecycle management. (Exposure to Government-to-Government (G2G) initiatives is a strong plus).
  • Exceptional stakeholder management, active listening, and relationship cultivation skills without reliance on aggressive transactional sales techniques.
  • Native or professional fluency in Thai and excellent command of English (both written and spoken) for cross-border corporate and institutional correspondence.

Why This Role Is Attractive

  • Strategic & Institutional Impact: Directly shape cross-border trade and investment corridors between two leading ASEAN economies.
  • High-Altitude Networking: Build an influential network spanning C-level business leaders, key chambers of commerce, and government decision-makers.

job.title: Product Manager
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm's Healthcare Division is partnering with a growing Pharmaceutical company to hire a Product Manager to be based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

The Product Manager will be responsible for overseeing the lifecycle of pharmaceutical products, from development to commercialization. This includes managing the product portfolio, strategic planning, market analysis, and working cross-functionally with sales, marketing, regulatory, and R&D teams. The role requires a deep understanding of the pharmaceutical market, strong project management skills, and the ability to drive product success in a competitive environment.

Key Responsibilities:
Product Strategy & Planning:

  • Develop and implement product strategies in alignment with overall business goals.
  • Collaborate with senior management to define product positioning, market access strategies, and pricing strategies.
  • Monitor and analyze industry trends, competitor products, and regulatory developments to ensure product success and compliance.

Product Lifecycle Management:

  • Manage the product lifecycle from development to launch, ensuring products meet market needs and regulatory requirements.
  • Coordinate with R&D and regulatory teams to guide products through development stages, clinical trials, and approvals.
  • Ensure timely product launches by managing timelines, resources, and key stakeholders.

Market Analysis & Consumer Insights:

  • Conduct in-depth market research to identify customer needs, competitive landscape, and potential opportunities for product improvement or expansion.
  • Gather and analyze feedback from customers, sales teams, and healthcare professionals to refine product offerings.

Sales & Marketing Support:

  • Support the development of product positioning and messaging that highlights the product's unique value proposition.
  • Provide training and ongoing support to the sales team to ensure they are equipped to effectively promote the product.
  • Track and analyze product performance, customer feedback, and sales trends to inform future strategies.

Financial Performance & Budgeting:

  • Monitor the financial performance of the product portfolio, including revenue, costs, and profitability.
  • Manage product budgets and collaborate with finance to ensure efficient allocation of resources.

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Business, Marketing or a related field.
  • Experience in the therapeutic area relevant to the Obstetric & Gynaecology or Orthopaedics is preferred
  • 3-5 years of experience in product management, brand management, or related roles within the pharmaceutical industry.
  • Strong understanding of the pharmaceutical industry, product lifecycle management, and market dynamics.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams including regulatory, marketing, and sales.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities.

job.description:

Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Industrial & Construction sector to hire a Chief Operating Officer (COO). This opportunity is based in Selangor, Malaysia.
Position Overview
Lead the overall business operations to drive sustainable growth, operational excellence, profitability, and customer satisfaction across the organisation.
Provide executive leadership in shaping operational and commercial strategies while ensuring profitable project delivery, strong governance, and long-term business competitiveness.
Key Responsibilities
Business & Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and execute the company's operational strategy aligned with corporate vision and business objectives.
  • Drive sustainable revenue growth, profitability, operational excellence, and market competitiveness.

  • Identify new business opportunities, partnerships, and market expansion strategies.

Operational Excellence

  • Lead the overall operations of the business, including Engineering, Project Management, Fabrication, Installation, Procurement and Logistics.

  • Drive productivity improvement, operational efficiency, and cost optimisation initiatives.

Commercial & Financial Performance

  • Own the overall Profit & Loss (P&L) performance.
  • Drive business profitability through effective project execution, cost control, productivity improvement, and resource optimisation.
  • Review tender strategies, project pricing, commercial risks, and contract negotiations.
  • Monitor project profitability, cash flow, working capital, and operational budgets.

Project & Customer Delivery

  • Provide executive oversight on all roofing, façade cladding, architectural metal, and steel structure projects.
  • Ensure effective project governance from tender award through project completion.
  • Resolve major project, contractual, commercial, or operational issues.
  • Maintain strong relationships with key clients, consultants, architects, developers, contractors, and strategic partners.

Health, Safety, Quality & Compliance

  • Champion a strong safety culture across workshop and site operations.
  • Ensure compliance with CIDB, DOSH, ISO, and relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Lead incident investigations and corrective action implementation.
  • Drive quality management and continuous improvement programs.

Customer & Stakeholder Management

  • Build strong relationships with clients, consultants, architects, developers, and contractors.
  • Participate in project meetings and strategic customer engagements.
  • Ensure high customer satisfaction through effective project delivery.
  • Support business development initiatives by providing technical and operational expertise.

People Leadership

  • Lead and develop project managers, engineers, supervisors, site teams, and support functions.
  • Establish succession plans and capability development programs.
  • Drive a performance-oriented culture with clear accountability.
  • Foster collaboration across departments.

Strategic Growth

  • Identify opportunities to expand operational capabilities and market presence.
  • Evaluate new technologies, fabrication methods, and installation techniques.
  • Support expansion into regional projects in line with company growth ambitions.

Key Requirements
Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Architecture, or related field.
  • Possess at least 15-20 years of experience in construction, roofing, façade, cladding, steel structures, or building materials industries and minimum 10 years in a senior leadership position.
  • Proven track record of managing full business operations with accountability for P&L, operational performance, and strategic growth.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Demonstrated experience managing Engineering, Project Management, Fabrication, Installation, Procurement and Logistics functions.
  • Strong commercial acumen with experience in tender strategies, project pricing, commercial risk assessment, and contract negotiations.
  • Proven expertise in driving project profitability, cash flow management, working capital optimisation, and operational budget control.
  • Experience establishing operational governance frameworks, performance management systems, and business KPIs.
  • Strong understanding of roofing, façade cladding, architectural metal, and steel structure projects.
  • Knowledge of CIDB, DOSH, ISO, and relevant regulatory requirements.
  • Experience leading quality management, incident investigations, corrective action implementation, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Ability to evaluate and implement new technologies, fabrication methods, and installation techniques.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Excellent command of English, with the ability to communicate and deliver presentations effectively.
  • Strong leadership skills with the ability to lead both direct teams and cross-functional departments, integrating complex initiatives across multiple business areas.
  • Exceptional organisational and time management skills, with high attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building capabilities.
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to drive business growth, operational excellence, and organisational transformation.
  • Ability to foster collaboration, accountability, and a high-performance culture across the organisation.

job.title: Senior Area Sales Manager
job.description:
Senior Area Sales Manager, BU Egg

Location: Malaysia

Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment Firm, is partnering with a leading organisation within the Industrial sector to hire a Senior Area Sales Manager, BU Egg based in Malaysia.

Position Overview

Lead the growth and commercial performance of the company's egg business unit by developing business opportunities, driving sales strategies, and strengthening market presence across the region.
This role plays a critical part in achieving revenue, profitability, and market share objectives while supporting product development, customer engagement, and regional collaboration initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the Company's Egg sales-related activities including developing new business, growth strategies and opportunities and maximising long-term profitable volume growth.
  • Realise sales budget (target) both in volume, margin and market share.
  • Analyse the market and determine the sales strategy including a market-specific pricing policy.
  • Participate in generating "Proven Solutions", sales manuals, product and solution templates for proposals, meetings, workshops and other specific sales material.
  • Recommend and take part in trade shows and other relevant marketing projects.
  • Resolve customer complaints regarding sales and service and manage key client relationships.
  • Recommend and implement detailed annual sales operating plans and preparation of sales performance reports for strategic analysis and review on a monthly or quarterly basis.
  • Collect and share product ideas/market requirements. Actively participate in the design of BU Egg related products in collaboration with the customer solutions, engineering and HQ.
  • Assist in the roll out of new products to the relevant countries in our region.
  • Assist and lead the project sales with consulting on farm management level.
  • Determine training requirements for BU Egg sales team.
  • Liaise with respective Asia regions to conduct BU Egg product trainings regionally.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Animal Production or any other equivalent qualification.
  • Minimum 5 years' experience in investment goods with relevant experience as a Sales Manager with P&L responsibilities.
  • Those with sales production or sales engineering experience in the fields of agriculture shall be favourably considered.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Proven ability to develop new business, growth strategies and market opportunities.
  • Experience in achieving sales budgets covering volume, margin and market share targets.
  • Strong market analysis and sales strategy development capabilities, including pricing strategy formulation.
  • Experience in developing sales materials, solution proposals, sales manuals and product templates.
  • Ability to prepare detailed annual sales operating plans and sales performance reports for strategic review.
  • Experience in product development collaboration with customer solutions, engineering and head office stakeholders.
  • Exposure to new product rollout initiatives across multiple countries.
  • Experience leading project sales and providing farm management-level consultation.
  • Knowledge of training needs assessment and sales capability development programmes.
  • Ability to work across regional teams to coordinate and conduct product training programmes.
  • Willingness and ability to travel within the Asia region.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Excellent business acumen with a proven business track record.
  • Excellent networking and interpersonal skills.
  • Proactive and able to work independently.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong leadership and coaching skills with evidence of building, retaining and motivating a high-performing sales team.

job.title: Government Relations Specialist (East Malaysia)
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Professional Services sector to hire a Government Relations Specialist, East Malaysia. This opportunity is based in East Malaysia.

Position Overview
The role spearheads strategic advocacy and external engagement efforts with key stakeholders in East Malaysia. It directly contributes to strengthening justice system responses and advancing policy frameworks to protect vulnerable workers.

Key Responsibilities


  • Coordinate and implement advocacy and external engagement efforts with key stakeholders in East Malaysia, ensuring alignment with strategies set by the Government Relations Manager.

  • Provide strategic input to the Program Support Specialist on stakeholder engagement, advocacy and policy reform opportunities.

  • Guide the team to ensure strategic external engagements that lead directly to project outcomes.

  • Develop and implement advocacy strategies aligned with IJM’s Protection Model, Advocacy Goals and Program Goals for East Malaysia.

  • Develop strategy and plans to activate stakeholders to influence the government on forced labour and labour trafficking issues.

  • Prepare background, strategic insights, plans and briefing documents toward advocacy and engagements with government, private partners, local and global development communities.

  • Ensure East Malaysia strategies and insights are communicated regularly to the Government Relations Manager for integration into national policy and systems change strategies.

  • Adapt national level advocacy frameworks to the East Malaysia context.

  • Remain up to date on policy reforms, media reports and relevant trends on national and state levels.

  • Map and engage key stakeholders with influence over labour protection and anti-trafficking efforts in Sabah and Sarawak.

  • Identify, facilitate, and manage strategic collaborations with government, civil society, and private sector partners.

  • Represent the organisation in meetings, forums, and coalitions to promote justice system improvements.

  • Facilitate multi-stakeholder dialogues, roundtables, and joint initiatives to promote systemic change.

  • Contribute to the development of training materials and advocacy resources.

  • Document lessons learned and best practices for internal and external knowledge sharing.

  • Provide capacity-building trainings in collaboration with programme teams and relevant specialists.

  • Maintain comprehensive records of strategic relationships, project activities, and advocacy outcomes.

  • Track progress against advocacy goals and contribute to quarterly and annual reporting.

  • Engage in regular coordination meetings with the Government Relations Manager to ensure harmonisation of national and East Malaysian strategies.

  • Provide timely updates and flag emerging political or stakeholder issues.

Key Requirements


  • Qualifications & Experience

  • Master’s degree in relevant field preferred.

  • Bachelor’s degree in humanities, social work, law, human rights, international development or related field, or equivalent work experience.

  • At least 5 years of experience in project development and implementation with diverse government and community-based groups.

  • Capacity-building experience desirable.

  • Strong knowledge of current issues on human trafficking, forced labour, international trafficking instruments and labour trafficking laws.

  • In-depth knowledge of federal and state government structures and dynamics.

  • Proven ability to work well at an inter-personal level with government and non-government stakeholders.

  • Established experience in networking with stakeholders across community spectrum.

  • Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.

  • Fluent in spoken and written English and Bahasa Malaysia.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.

  • Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Developed organisational and leadership skills, superior attention to detail, exceptional follow-through and accountability for results.

  • Excellent time management and ability to work effectively under deadline pressures.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with sound judgement.

  • Experience working independently in remote or decentralised settings.

  • Excellent interpersonal skills, cross-cultural communication, and ability to foster good working relations.

  • Flexible, enthusiastic, and willing to receive feedback and learn from others.

  • High level of honesty and integrity.

  • Courageous and humble servant leader.

  • Passion and commitment for the mission and theory of change.

job.title: R&D Chemist
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with a leading organisation in the Industrial sector to hire an R&D Chemist. This opportunity is based in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

Position Overview

This role supports pilot-scale R&D trials in edible oil refining and modification, delivering accurate chemical and instrumental analysis to underpin process development. It plays a direct part in advancing the organisation's innovation agenda across edible oils, fats, oleochemicals, biodiesel and renewable fuels.

Key Responsibilities

You will contribute directly to the organisation's technology development by generating accurate analytical data, supporting both pilot- and lab-scale process trials, and participating in innovation projects across edible oils, fats, oleochemicals, biodiesel, and renewable fuels.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Assist to laboratory and pilot-scale trials in edible oil refining, modification and oleochemical processes.
  • Participate in the preparation, execution, monitoring and reporting of R&D experiments.
  • Conduct chemical and instrumental analysis with our state-of-the-art analytical equipment.
  • Validate and apply official analytical methods in line with industry standards.
  • Ensure proper calibration, maintenance records, and laboratory documentation are kept up to date.
  • Manage laboratory chemicals, consumables and inventory in compliance with internal and regulatory requirements.

Safety & Compliance

  • Lead the implementation of laboratory safety protocols (chemical handling, waste management, PPE compliance, risk assessments).
  • Ensure the analytical and sample preparation areas are fully compliant with HSE standards.
  • Conduct periodic safety training and ensure safe operation of all analytical equipment.
  • Work closely with process engineers, R&D engineers, group specialists and external partners (universities, institutes, customers).

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Prior experience in a laboratory or R&D environment, ideally within edible oils, fats, oleochemicals or a related process industry.
  • Experience supporting or leading laboratory safety protocols and HSE compliance is advantageous.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Strong hands-on skills in operating, maintaining and troubleshooting analytical equipment.
  • Solid understanding of chemical analysis related to edible oils and fats (FFA, DOBI, peroxide value, fatty acid profile, moisture, stability, etc.).
  • Ability to validate and apply official analytical methods in line with industry standards.
  • Knowledge of laboratory safety practices and chemical management, including calibration, maintenance records and documentation.
  • Experience managing laboratory chemicals, consumables and inventory in compliance with internal and regulatory requirements.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Accurate, detail-oriented and able to produce reliable analytical data under time constraints.
  • Strong critical thinking and structured reporting skills.
  • Ability to lead the implementation of safety protocols and conduct periodic safety training.
  • Effective collaborator, able to work closely with process engineers, R&D engineers, group specialists and external partners such as universities, institutes and customers.

job.title: Technical Manager
job.description:
Technical Manager

Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with a leading organisation in the Industrial sector to hire a Senior Technical Manager. This opportunity is based in Malaysia.

Position Overview

The Technical Manager will oversee the technical, financial and operational delivery of maintenance and project activities, ensuring works are completed to specification, on schedule and within budget. This role plays a critical part in safeguarding the organisation's operational integrity, regulatory compliance and long-term asset reliability.

Key Responsibilities

  1. To strictly follow and adhere to all Company policies and approved procedures on business ethics, SSHE and others.
  2. Manage the financial aspect of all maintenance works and projects following the approved budget.
  3. Responsible for the maintenance and project from inception to completion of jobs, meeting the technical requirement, schedule and budget.
  4. Liaise with Contractors and Consultants on various maintenance works and projects.
  5. Assist with requirements in relation to site preparation and associated consultations.
  6. To assist in procurement of spare parts, consumables and equipment and ensure that the procurement procedure is followed, meeting the technical specification and budget.
  7. To participate in technical discussions internally as well as with customers, suppliers, contractors and authorities, during the tender review, technical clarifications and site meetings.
  8. To develop and execute a preventive maintenance plan on critical equipment and monitor the implementation.
  9. To attend to maintenance problems arising from daily operational activities.
  10. To plan, monitor, execute and maintain calibration records and certificates of fitness of critical equipment.
  11. To strictly comply with the Company's HSSE regulations when carrying out maintenance activities. In the absence of the Company's as well as government regulations on maintenance activities to be carried out, best practice rules apply.
  12. To play an active role in the Emergency Response Team, ISO9001:2008 and Safety Committee.
  13. Any other duties and responsibilities as delegated by the General Manager and immediate superior.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Degree or professional qualification in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Civil or a related discipline), or equivalent industry experience.
  • Proven experience in a technical/maintenance management role within an industrial, terminal or process operations environment.
  • Demonstrated experience managing maintenance and project works from inception through to completion, including budget and schedule accountability.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Strong working knowledge of maintenance planning, project management and financial/budget control for maintenance and project works.
  • Experience in procurement processes for spare parts, consumables and equipment, ensuring alignment with technical specifications and budgetary requirements.
  • Proficiency in developing and executing preventive maintenance plans for critical equipment, including monitoring of implementation.
  • Experience in calibration planning, execution, record-keeping and maintaining certificates of fitness for critical equipment.
  • Sound knowledge of SSHE/HSSE regulations, company policies and best practice standards applicable to maintenance activities.
  • Familiarity with ISO9001:2008 quality management systems.
  • Experience participating in tender reviews, technical clarifications and site meetings with customers, suppliers, contractors and authorities.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Strong stakeholder management and liaison skills, with the ability to engage effectively with contractors, consultants, customers, suppliers and authorities.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to respond promptly to maintenance issues arising from daily operations.
  • Strong organisational and multitasking abilities to manage competing priorities across maintenance and project portfolios.
  • High level of integrity and commitment to business ethics, safety and compliance standards.
  • Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, for internal and external technical discussions.
  • Active and collaborative approach to emergency response and safety committee participation.
  • Ability to work independently and exercise sound judgement, particularly in the absence of specific regulatory guidance.

job.title: QSHE Manager
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with a leading organisation in the Industrial sector to hire a QSHE Manager. This opportunity is based in Malaysia.

Position Overview

This role is responsible for maintaining, developing and continually improving the organisation's Quality, Safety, Health and Environment (QSHE) Management System in line with ISO 9001, ISO 14001 and applicable Health & Safety legislation. It plays a critical role in embedding a strong safety culture and ensuring regulatory compliance across the site, directly supporting the organisation's operational integrity and reputation.

Key Responsibilities

Job Purpose

To maintain, develop and continually improve all the company's QSHE Management System in accordance with ISO 9001; ISO 14001, the requirements of Health & Safety Legislation and any other requirements.

To ensure and arrange the provision of elementary Health & Safety training to all staff as required, including, but not limited to Risk Assessment, Manual Handling, Accident Investigation and Reporting, Hazard and Defect Reporting, Environmental Awareness and other relevant training needs as required.

Tasks and Responsibilities

  • Write, review & maintain local HSE and Quality System procedures, ensuring they are all available on the SharePoint.
  • Acting as a focal point for the site to ensure that global quality & SHE procedures and protocols are made available to, understood and completed by the relevant departments.
  • Communicate information related to QHSE to all the employees and promotes HSE awareness through various communication channels i.e. inductions, training, discussions, emails, etc. in consultation with all relevant departments.
  • Locally lead and maintain ISO9001:2015 accreditation.
  • Locally lead and maintain ISO 14001:2015 accreditation.
  • Locally lead and maintain Halal accreditation.
  • Locally lead any new accreditation in line with the CPL strategy.
  • Complete the annual internal audit programme for Quality & SHE, conducting audits including:
  • Internal Quality System audits
  • Hygiene audits in the laboratory and production areas
  • Safety auditing for fire, storage racking etc.
  • Complete SHE training for the site corrosives handling, standard operating procedures, fire procedures. Manage and arrange all trainings related to QSHE.
  • Interpret, build upon and comply with company policies and the recognised set of international standards.
  • Management of the annual programme of SHE risk assessments and follow up.
  • Co-ordinate internal and external Non-Conformance System. Liaise with the relevant departments to put in place corrective actions to prevent reoccurrence.
  • Recording, investigating and reporting to relevant level of management in accordance with our legal responsibilities of safety & environmental incidents and following up actions to prevent recurrence. Suggest and advise changes to ensure continuous improvement on any additional effective OFIs to be added as part of continual improvement.
  • Controlling both hazardous & non-hazardous wastes and keeping accurate records.
  • Ensure waste management procedures are always followed and all documentation required by law is received and all permits are current.
  • Ensure the workplace is free from hazards and excellent hygiene and housekeeping standards are maintained and meet expectations.
  • Complete supplier questionnaires, Long Term Supplier Declarations and other QSHE related requests from stakeholders.
  • Compilation of spreadsheets, graphs and reports on KPI's for discussion at management and performance review meetings.
  • Collation of utility consumption figures, along with compilation & publication of monthly graphs.
  • Develop, implement and encourage the behavioural based safety culture in the company through safe job observations.
  • Ensure compliance with the QSHE management systems, relevant Health, Safety & Environmental legislation.
  • Drive continuous improvement of core processes to ensure manufacturing QSHE is maintained while efficiency is optimised.
  • Support facilities management coordinator as and when required.
  • Adhere to the quality, environmental, health and safety standards of the company.

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Candidate must be an SHO green book holder and possess a Bachelor's Degree / Diploma in Safety & Health, or be certified by NIOSH or equivalent.

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Up to date knowledge of all EHS / Authorities QHSE requirements.
  • Understanding of QSHE Risk Management tools would be an advantage.
  • High level of numeracy skills.
  • Knowledge and experience within Quality Assurance or Control procedures within a manufacturing environment would be a distinct advantage.
  • Knowledge and experience of Health and Safety in a manufacturing environment would be a distinct advantage.

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • A friendly / helpful attitude.
  • Able to work efficiently and effectively with attention to detail, even when under pressure.
  • Customer oriented.
  • A highly organised and professional approach to managing a demanding workload.
  • A great team player with the ability to work with minimal supervision.

job.title: Quality Manager
job.description:
Introduction / Context

  • Monroe Consulting Group, an Executive Recruitment firm, is partnering with an organisation in the Industrial sector to hire a Quality Manager. This opportunity is based in Malaysia.

Position Overview

  • Oversee and drive all quality assurance and control activities within a manufacturing environment.
  • Ensure robust quality systems, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement to enhance operational performance and product reliability.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Oversee all aspects of quality assurance and control within our manufacturing facility.
  • Ensures implementation and improvement of the quality part of the Integrated Management System (including process management) according to corporate quality strategy and respective local regulations.
  • Cooperates closely with relevant internal stakeholders across geographies, i.e. R&D, Purchasing, Engineering, Manufacturing, corporate quality, etc.
  • Understanding customer needs and requirements to develop effective quality control processes.
  • Lead supplier quality activities including incoming quality, SCAR management, change control and capability evidence (Cpk).
  • Drive PFMEA, SPC and structured problem solving (8D, CAPA, DMAIC) to secure stable process performance.
  • Oversee all product development procedures to identify deviations from quality standards.
  • Plans, implements and follows up the audit programme (including certification audits where applicable) and assessments to ensure compliance with quality standards and regulatory requirements; copy exact experience will be a plus
  • Foster an open error reporting culture with early escalation, rapid containment and strong root cause prevention.
  • Prepare regular reports on quality performance for management review.
  • Provide leadership to cross-functional teams to resolve customer quality, product and application issues
  • Fosters team skills and motivation to achieve quality objectives

Key Requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • At least 7 years of total work experience in relevant industries, of which at least 5 years is in Quality or Quality-related scope
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams
  • Degree in Electrical and Electronics Engineering, or similar discipline
  • Knowledge or direct exposure on wireless communications/RF engineering, PCB or equivalent related technical experience in fields of electronic test equipment preferred
  • Relevant experience in semiconductor manufacturing is a plus
  • Ability to develop a solutions-based approach in corrective measures for defective parts, failure rates from component to assembly
  • Ability to act as a catalyst for change and improvement in performance and quality
  • Good understanding of quality management system ISO 9001, Six Sigma and other quality methods
  • Expertise in PFMEA, SPC, Cpk/stability analysis and 8D/CAPA
  • Strong leadership, audit readiness skills and communication across suppliers and customers

Technical / Functional Expertise

  • Quality assurance and control in manufacturing environments
  • Integrated Management System implementation and process management
  • Supplier quality management including SCAR, change control, and Cpk analysis
  • Structured problem-solving methodologies: PFMEA, SPC, 8D, CAPA, DMAIC
  • Audit programme planning, certification audits, and compliance assessments
  • Quality management systems including ISO 9001 and Six Sigma
  • Wireless communications/RF engineering, PCB, or electronic test equipment exposure
  • Semiconductor manufacturing knowledge (advantageous)
  • Data analysis related to failure rates, component performance, and assembly quality
  • Cross-functional collaboration with R&D, Engineering, Manufacturing, and Purchasing

Soft Skills & Leadership Competencies

  • Strong leadership and team development capabilities
  • Effective communication across cross-functional and multicultural teams
  • Customer-focused mindset with a strong understanding of quality requirements
  • Problem-solving orientation with a structured and analytical approach
  • Ability to drive change, continuous improvement, and performance enhancement
  • High level of accountability and audit readiness discipline
  • Collaborative and influential stakeholder management skills
  • Resilience and adaptability within a dynamic manufacturing environment

job.description:

  • Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills.

job.title: Senior Food Waste Specialist
job.description:
Monroe Consulting Group is representing a prestigious international initiative dedicated to sustainability and circular economy solutions. Our client is driving a major collaborative movement in Indonesia, GRASP2030, which focuses on transforming food systems, reducing food loss, and optimizing supply chain efficiencies. They are currently seeking a highly skilled and culturally fluent technical expert to lead field implementation and data-driven interventions across the country.


Job Purpose

The Senior Food Specialist will lead the design and delivery of technical workstreams for GRASP2030 and related projects in Indonesia. Operating within a collaborative, multi-partner consortium model, this role provides hands-on technical capabilities across retail, manufacturing, processing, and hospitality/food service environments.

The successful candidate will act as a central delivery engine—generating high-quality evidence, supply-chain hotspot analyses, and operational insights to help businesses, funders, and strategic partners eliminate food waste and improve environmental performance.

Key Responsibilities


  • Technical Delivery & Evidence Generation: Lead technical assessments, operational diagnostics, intervention designs, and waste audits across diverse business environments. Utilize data measurement tools, digital capture systems, and dashboards to collect and present reliable evidence that meets strict accuracy standards.

  • Field Implementation & Project Management: Work directly with businesses to execute on-site pilots, trials, and case studies in settings like hotels, restaurants, canteens, factories, and waste facilities. Develop comprehensive workplans, operational protocols, and risk management frameworks while supervising external field enumerators or data collectors when necessary.

  • Stakeholder Engagement & Behaviour Change: Build trusted, culturally grounded relationships with Indonesian businesses at all levels—from frontline staff to senior executives. Facilitate workshops and training sessions to embed long-lasting behaviour changes and improved operational practices within local organizational contexts.

  • Consortium Collaboration & Advisory: Maintain close coordination and alignment with local partner networks (including IBCSD), technical partners, and international donors to manage overlapping priorities. Provide evidence-based insights to advise on future project designs, funding prospects, and scaling options.

  • Communication & Reporting: Produce clear, accessible technical reports, case studies, and data summaries for corporate, government, and funding stakeholders. Deliver confident communications in both Bahasa Indonesia and English.


Requirements & Qualifications


  • Education: Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) in Environmental Science, Food Technology, Sustainability, Engineering, Public Health, or a related technical discipline. A postgraduate qualification is desirable but not required.

  • Experience & Technical Knowledge: Strong foundational understanding of Indonesia’s food system challenges, specifically regarding food loss and waste across supply chains. Exposure to circular economy frameworks, packaging materials, and climate impacts is highly valued.

  • Languages: Native or professional fluency in Bahasa Indonesia is required , alongside strong, professional English proficiency.

  • Key Skills: Ability to translate field findings into concrete business recommendations. Familiarity with digital data capture systems or basic GHG emissions calculations relevant to supply chains is a distinct advantage.

  • Certifications (Preferred): Professional certifications in food safety, waste auditing, GHG accounting, or Lean/Six Sigma are considered an asset.

  • Mobility & Dynamics: Must be based in Jakarta , willing to travel within Indonesia for field implementation , and comfortable managing regular virtual meetings with international teams across different time zones.

job.title: Senior Data Engineer
job.description:
The role
We’re hiring a hands-on Data Engineer to own our SQL data estate, design scalable pipelines, and lead data enrichment across our Azure-first platform. You’ll set the standards for modeling, quality, security, and cost while writing production-grade Python and SQL daily.
What you’ll own
SQL Databases

  • Design and evolve schemas for OLTP/OLAP (Azure SQL, Synapse, Delta Lake), with partitioning, indexing, and RLS for multi-tenant isolation.
  • Establish data contracts and versioning, govern schema evolution, and implement CDC + SCD patterns.
  • Performance engineering: query tuning, resource classes, caching strategies, and cost guardrails.

Data Pipelines

  • Architect ELT/ETL across batch & streaming using Azure Data Factory/Synapse/Databricks, Event Hubs/Service Bus, Functions, and Container Apps/AKS.
  • Build reliable, observable pipelines (idempotent, retryable, lineage-aware) with SLAs/SLOs and runbooks.
  • Implement CI/CD for data (dbt/SQL projects, PySpark jobs, tests) using GitHub Actions and IaC (Terraform/Bicep).

Data Enrichment

  • Define and operate enrichment layers: UPC/GS1, OCR/EXIF metadata, taxonomies, embeddings, and third-party data joins.
  • Curate gold/semantic models for analytics & product APIs; manage feature/metric definitions and documentation.
  • Partner with DS/ML to operationalize feature stores, model outputs, drift signals, and evaluation tables.

Azure Architecture & Governance

  • Own reference architecture across ADLS Gen2, Synapse/Databricks, Azure SQL/SQL Server, Cosmos DB (incl. vector), Azure AI Search, Key Vault, Purview.
  • Security & compliance by default: encryption, secret management, RBAC/ABAC, data retention and GDPR/SOC 2 controls.
  • Observability: OpenTelemetry + Azure Monitor/App Insights, data quality tests, freshness SLAs, and lineage in Purview.

What you’ll build (examples)

  • A durable image ingestion & enrichment pipeline: validate assets, extract OCR/UPC, compute embeddings, store lineage, publish search-ready views.
  • A hybrid retrieval layer (vector + filters) across Cosmos DB/Azure AI Search for similarity and recommendations.

Minimum qualifications

  • Extremely strong Python & SQL (you can diagnose complex query plans, write PySpark and pandas with equal ease).
  • 7+ years in data engineering/architecture with production ownership of SQL databases and pipelines.
  • Deep Azure experience: ADLS Gen2, Data Factory/Synapse/Databricks, Azure SQL/SQL Server, Functions, Event Hubs/Service Bus, Key Vault.
  • Proven design skills in data modeling (star/snowflake, Data Vault/Lakehouse), CDC/SCD, and semantics (dbt or equivalent).
  • Track record implementing data quality frameworks, lineage, and cost/performance guardrails at scale.
  • Strong understanding of multi-tenant SaaS, security, and privacy (GDPR basics).

Nice to have

  • Cosmos DB (incl. vector) and Azure AI Search; embedding pipelines for images/text.
  • Feature stores, MLflow/registries, real-time inference plumbing.
  • SQL Server internals, PolyBase/Serverless SQL; Postgres familiarity.
  • Purview rollouts, governance programs, and data product operating models.

Our stack
Azure (ADLS Gen2, Data Factory, Synapse, Databricks, Functions, Event Hubs, Key Vault, Monitor)
Delta/Parquet, Azure SQL/SQL Server, Cosmos DB (vector), Azure AI Search
Python (pandas, PySpark, FastAPI for data services), dbt (or equivalent), GitHub Actions, Terraform/Bicep
Observability: OpenTelemetry, Azure Monitor/App Insights, Sentry/Datadog (where applicable)
Our commitment to inclusion
Behaviorally is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, veteran status, citizenship status, or any other protected characteristic.

job.title: Justice System Program Manager
job.description:
About the Role

We are supporting one of our key clients which is a global, mission-driven organization dedicated to protecting people from violence, exploitation, and injustice, working alongside communities, government institutions, and civil society partners.


As their work in Indonesia continues to grow and give impacts, they are seeking an active Advocate Licensed professional as the Legal Services Lead to guide their holistic legal caseworks and strengthen justice systems for long-term change.


Responsibilities

Leadership & Legal Stewardship

  • Provide ethical, strategic leadership for all legal intervention activities, ensuring alignment with organizational standards and best practices.
  • Oversee the legal docket and guide the legal team to deliver high-quality, survivor-centered case outcomes.
  • Monitor progress against legal strategies and work plans, identifying challenges and proposing solutions.
  • Prepare thoughtful and timely reports that reflect learning, impact, and areas for improvement.
  • Support implementation of legal components within broader program strategies and donor-funded initiatives.

Casework & Legal Advocacy

  • Apply strong knowledge of Indonesian criminal law, labor law, and laws related to forced labor and human trafficking.
  • Support and collaborate with public prosecutors in criminal cases involving trafficking and exploitation.
  • Build trusted relationships with prosecutors, judges, law enforcement, lawyers, paralegals, and NGO partners.
  • Lead the preparation of legal briefs, memoranda, and court submissions.
  • Develop litigation strategies that prioritize survivor safety, dignity, and access to justice.
  • Represent survivors in criminal and civil proceedings, including trials and appeals.
  • Pursue accountability for perpetrators while advocating for survivor remedies such as compensation and unpaid wages.
  • Provide legal guidance to internal teams and partners supporting law enforcement engagement and survivor care.

Partnership & Capacity Building

  • Develop and coordinate networks of lawyers and paralegals to ensure survivors receive legal support throughout the justice process.
  • Work closely with partner organizations to strengthen referrals, legal strategies, and collaboration.
  • Design and facilitate legal trainings for government institutions and civil society partners on trafficking, forced labor, and related legal procedures.

Resource & Compliance Management

  • Contribute to planning and management of budgets related to legal casework and capacity-building activities.
  • Ensure responsible stewardship of resources in line with organizational values and policies.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor of Law required; Master of Law preferred.
  • Licensed member of the Indonesian Advocates Association (PERADI).
  • At least 5–7 years of legal experience, ideally in criminal litigation, human rights, NGO legal work, or private practice.
  • Strong legal research, writing, and advocacy skills.
  • Fluency in both English and Bahasa Indonesia, written and spoken.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and respectfully with diverse stakeholders.


What We’re Looking For

  • A values-driven legal professional committed to justice, accountability, and survivor-centered approaches.
  • A calm and resilient leader who can navigate emotionally demanding and high-pressure situations.
  • Strong people leadership and mentoring skills, with cultural sensitivity and emotional intelligence.
  • Collaborative, humble, and relationship-oriented, with the ability to work effectively across institutions.
  • Someone who believes that sustainable justice requires both legal excellence and deep compassion.

job.title: Senior Backend Engineer
job.description:
Executive Monroe Consulting Group is recruiting on behalf of a #1 global market leader in digital shopper marketing. Our client is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer. This job offers a Hybrid arrangement (3x onsite, 2x WFH in a week) located in Makati and on a night shift.

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Backend Engineer to join our steadily growing engineering team. This role involves designing secure, scalable APIs and data services that power our myBehaviorally SaaS platform. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in Python and SQL, Azure cloud services, and building reliable integrations (HubSpot, Outlook/SMTP, OpenAI), with a passion for partnering cross-functionally to bring the product vision to life.

Key Job Responsibilities:


  • Own the backend development of our next-generation B2B SaaS product: Django REST APIs consumed by a React SPA through App Gateway + WAF.

  • Implement secure authentication/authorization (Azure AD SSO, optional Okta), role-based access, and multi-tenant patterns

  • Build and operate resilient async pipelines (Celery/Redis) for file processing and job orchestration; expose job status to the UI

  • Integrate external systems: HubSpot (REST/webhooks), Outlook/SMTP notifications, and OpenAI endpoints for workflow automation

  • Design and maintain schemas in Azure SQL; manage artifacts/results in Azure Blob Storage with proper retention and lineage.

  • Ensure the performance, scalability, and reliability of internal-facing and external-facing services; profile and optimize Python code and SQL.

  • Instrument observability (structured logs, metrics, tracing via App Insights/Azure Monitor/OpenTelemetry); create runbooks and SLAs/SLOs.

  • Write well-crafted, well-tested, readable, and maintainable code; contribute to code reviews and engineering standards.

  • Keep up to date with backend, security, and Azure best practices; participate in threat modeling and periodic hardening.

Key Job Qualifications:


  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, or related field.

  • At least 5 years of experience building production backend systems with Python (Django/DRF or FastAPI) and SQL

  • Track record designing and operating RESTful APIs and asynchronous workers (Celery/Redis), including idempotency, retries, and monitoring.

  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure (App Service, App Gateway + WAF, Azure AD/OIDC, Key Vault, Azure SQL, Blob Storage, Monitor/App Insights).

  • Proven experience integrating third-party platforms (e.g., HubSpot APIs, webhooks; SMTP/Outlook; OpenAI APIs).

  • Strong data modeling and query-tuning skills; comfortable with schema migrations and performance diagnostics.

  • Proficient with testing and CI/CD (pytest, Git/GitHub, GitHub Actions); code reviews and documentation.

  • Solid understanding of security best practices (OWASP, secrets management, RBAC, encryption at rest/in transit) and awareness of GDPR.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills, resourceful, proactive, and willing to take ownership.

  • Startup experience is a major plus.

  • Proven experience working with React and Typescript a definite plus

job.title: Technical Engineer
job.description:
Executive recruitment company Monroe Consulting Group Malaysia's Engineering Division is recruiting on behalf of a client for a Technical Engineer position.

Job Summary

This role involves leading and optimizing plastic injection molding and PVC extrusion processes while supervising and training a team of technicians and operators. The successful candidate will troubleshoot mechanical and electrical issues to reduce downtime, manage technical projects from planning to completion, and ensure compliance with safety, quality, and environmental standards.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and optimize plastic injection molding and PVC extrusion processes.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve mechanical and electrical issues to reduce downtime.
  • Interpret and develop detailed wiring diagrams for machine upgrades and repairs.
  • Conduct regular inspections and preventive maintenance of equipment.
  • Identify and implement process improvements to enhance productivity and reduce costs.
  • Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and environmental standards.
  • Supervise and train a team of technicians and operators.
  • Conduct technical skills assessments and arrange ongoing training.
  • Foster a team culture focused on collaboration and continuous improvement.
  • Manage technical projects from planning to completion.
  • Coordinate with R&D, QA, and production teams to meet project goals.
  • Monitor project timelines and report progress to stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate records of maintenance, repairs, and production data.
  • Prepare technical reports and support internal and external audits.
  • Ensure all documentation complies with ISO and industry standards.


Key Requirements

  • Degree or Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.
  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in plastic mold injection and PVC extrusion.
  • Strong understanding of mechanical/electrical systems and tooling.
  • Proven leadership experience in managing technical or production teams.
  • Proficient in reading and creating wiring diagrams.
  • Good communication skills in English and Mandarin (spoken & written) is an added advantage.
  • Familiarity with industrial automation and robotics.
  • Experience with Lean Manufacturing, Kaizen, or Six Sigma.
  • Knowledge of ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, IATF 16949 standards.
  • - Able to perform under pressure and manage multiple priorities.

job.title: Marketing Manager
job.description:
Executive recruitment company Monroe Consulting Group Malaysia is recruiting on behalf of a leading confectionery and bakery. As business growth and expansion continues, our respected client is seeking an enthusiastic and highly motivated individual for the position of Marketing Manager. The opportunity is based in Johor Bahru, Malaysia.
 
You will support the Marketing department in driving the company’s brand, customer engagement, and business growth through integrated marketing strategies. In addition to managing branding, digital marketing, PR, and trade marketing, the team leads efforts to modernize the brand, enhance customer experience and respond to changing market trends.
 
Job Responsibilities:
Digital Marketing & Content Creation
  • Develop and roll out strategies for social platforms, the website, and email to effectively connect with our audience.
  • Generate original, compelling content (such as articles, videos, and visuals) in line with the bakery’s values and brand.
  • Lead SEO strategies to maximise online visibility and search rankings.
  • Track and analyse performance metrics, refining tactics to improve reach and engagement.
  • Manage digital assets including Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Xiaohongshu, web updates, and digital advertising.
 
Campaign Management & Brand Engagement
  • Organise and launch campaigns to boost sales, drive in-store visits, and strengthen customer retention.
  • Work cross-functionally to ensure marketing supports overall business objectives.
  • Coordinate activities like in-store promotions, events, roadshows, and influencer partnerships for greater brand exposure and improved customer experience.
  • Oversee media relations, public relations, sponsorship activities, and collaborations with other brands.
 
Analytics & Budget Control
  • Monitor the effectiveness of campaigns, focusing on ROI, engagement, and conversion rates.
  • Prepare detailed results reports with actionable recommendations for senior leaders.
  • Oversee the marketing budget to ensure effective resource allocation and return on investment.
  • Stay informed on market developments, customer trends, competitor moves, and explore new opportunities through ongoing research.
 
CRM & Customer Loyalty
  • Design and manage customer relationship initiatives and loyalty schemes to encourage long-term engagement.
  • Implement feedback channels to gather insights on customer perceptions and drive continual improvement.
  • Analyse customer data to fine-tune retention efforts and tailor marketing strategies.
 
Partnerships & Stakeholder Coordination
  • Manage collaborations with vendors, media, and creative agencies for unified brand messaging.
  • Represent the brand at industry conferences, trade fairs, or other events to boost visibility.
  • Foster communication within the organisation to ensure marketing strategies are well aligned across all departments.
 
Brand Stewardship & Customer Experience
  • Safeguard the bakery’s brand identity and ensure consistency across all communications and platforms.
  • Develop tactics to heighten brand awareness and improve market standing.
  • Oversee product presentation and in-store branding to reflect company values.
  • Ensure outstanding customer experiences by addressing feedback and maintaining high service standards.
  • Manage physical brand touchpoints like packaging, store signage, and branded materials.
  • Attend relevant industry events and exhibitions to represent the brand and expand its reach.
 
Key Competencies:
  • Demonstrated leadership and results orientation.
  • Superior communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Creative thinking, adaptability, and strategic insight into market trends.
  • Track record of managing multiple projects in a dynamic setting.
  • Strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to decision-making.
  • Dedication to delivering an outstanding, consistent brand experience.
  • Self-starter mentality with proactive problem-solving skills.
  • Highly organised with strong attention to detail and time management.
 
Requirements:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a similar discipline.
  • At least 5 years’ experience in marketing or brand management, including 2 years in a supervisory or leadership role.
  • Solid experience in planning and executing integrated marketing campaigns.
  • Strong digital marketing skills, including expertise in SEO, email marketing, and leading social media platforms (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Xiaohongshu).
  • Competence with analytics tools (such as Google Analytics); graphic design skills are a plus.
  • Proficiency in English, Malay, or Mandarin (for effective communication with partners and clients).
